prahlādastu bhayaṃ tyaktvā cakre padmāsanaṃ bhuvi .. 114 ..
17.18.d:
नो चेद्दर्शय तं विष्णुमस्मात्स्तंभाद्विनिर्गतम् ..
प्रह्लादस्तु भयं त्यक्त्वा चक्रे पद्मासनं भुवि .. 114 ..
17.18.m: Otherwise, show that Viṣṇu coming forth from this pillar!" / But Prahlāda, abandoning fear, assumed the lotus posture on the ground.

17.18.s:
vidhāya kaṃdharāṃ netumuccaiḥ śvāsaṃ nirudhya ca ..
hṛdi dhyātvā hariṃ devaṃ maraṇāyonmukhaḥ sthitaḥ .. 115 ..
17.18.d:
विधाय कंधरां नेतुमुच्चैः श्वासं निरुध्य च ..
हृदि ध्यात्वा हरिं देवं मरणायोन्मुखः स्थितः .. 115 ..
17.18.m: Holding his neck [upright] to direct [the breath] upward and restraining his breath, / meditating on the divine Hari in his heart, he waited, ready for death.

17.18.s:
prabho mayā tadā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ gaganādbhuvi ..
puṣpamālā sthitā kaṇṭhe prahlādasya svayaṃ gatā .. 116 ..
17.18.d:
प्रभो मया तदा दृष्टमाश्चर्यं गगनाद्भुवि ..
पुष्पमाला स्थिता कण्ठे प्रह्लादस्य स्वयं गता .. 116 ..
17.18.m: O Lord, then a wonder was seen by me falling from the sky to the earth: / a garland of flowers that was around the neck of Prahlāda moved by itself.

17.18.s:
gaganaṃ vyāpyamānaṃ ca kiṃkimevaṃ kṛtaṃ janaiḥ ..
jhaṭiti truṭyati stambhācchabdena kṣubhito janaḥ .. 117 ..
17.18.d:
गगनं व्याप्यमानं च किंकिमेवं कृतं जनैः ..
झटिति त्रुट्यति स्तम्भाच्छब्देन क्षुभितो जनः .. 117 ..
17.18.m: And as the sky was being filled, [people asked,] "What, what is being done by people?" / Suddenly, the people were agitated by the roar breaking from the pillar.

17.18.s:
dharaṇī yāti pātālaṃ dyaurvā bhūmiṃ sameṣyati ..
patiṣyati śiro bhūmau khaḍgaghātāhataṃ nu kim .. 118 ..
17.18.d:
धरणी याति पातालं द्यौर्वा भूमिं समेष्यति ..
पतिष्यति शिरो भूमौ खड्गघाताहतं नु किम् .. 118 ..
17.18.m: "Will the earth go to Pātāla, or will the sky come down to the ground? / Will his head fall to the earth, struck down by a blow of the sword?"

17.18.s:
tāvatstaṃbhādviniṣkrāntaḥ siṃhanādo bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
bhūmau nipatitāḥ sarve daityāḥ śabdena mūrcchitāḥ .. 119 ..
17.18.d:
तावत्स्तंभाद्विनिष्क्रान्तः सिंहनादो भयंकरः ..
भूमौ निपतिताः सर्वे दैत्याः शब्देन मूर्च्छिताः .. 119 ..
17.18.m: Just then, a terrifying lion's roar issued from the pillar; / all the Daityas fell to the ground, unconscious from the noise.

17.18.s:
hiraṇyakaśiporhastātkhaḍgacarma papāta ca ..
na sa jānāti kiṃ kimetaditi punaḥpunaḥ .. 7.2.18.120 ..
17.18.d:
हिरण्यकशिपोर्हस्तात्खड्गचर्म पपात च ..
न स जानाति किं किमेतदिति पुनःपुनः .. 7.2.18.120 ..
17.18.m: Sword and shield dropped from Hiraṇyakaśipu's hand; / he did not know what this was, [asking] again and again, "What is this?"

17.18.s:
utthito vīkṣate yāvattāvatpaśyati taṃ harim ..
adho naraṃ sthitaṃ siṃhamupariṣṭādvibhī ṣaṇam .. 121 ..
17.18.d:
उत्थितो वीक्षते यावत्तावत्पश्यति तं हरिम् ..
अधो नरं स्थितं सिंहमुपरिष्टाद्विभी षणम् .. 121 ..
17.18.m: As he stood up and looked, he saw that Hari: / a man below, a formidable lion above,

17.18.s:
daṃṣṭrā karālavadanaṃ lelihānamivāṃbaram ..
jājvalyamānavapuṣaṃ pucchācchoṭitamastakam .. 122 ..
17.18.d:
दंष्ट्रा करालवदनं लेलिहानमिवांबरम् ..
जाज्वल्यमानवपुषं पुच्छाच्छोटितमस्तकम् .. 122 ..
17.18.m: with a terrifying mouth full of fangs, as if licking the sky, / with a blazing body, striking his head with his tail,

17.18.s:
mahākaṇṭhakṛtārāvaṃ saśabda miva toyadam ..
samucchvasitakeśāṃtaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ surāsuraiḥ .. 123 ..
17.18.d:
महाकण्ठकृतारावं सशब्द मिव तोयदम् ..
समुच्छ्वसितकेशांतं दुर्निरीक्ष्यं सुरासुरैः .. 123 ..
17.18.m: making a loud roar from his great throat like a rumbling cloud, / with his mane standing upright, difficult to behold for gods and demons.

17.18.s:
narasiṃhamatho dṛṣṭvā nipapāta punaḥ kṣitau ..
vigṛhya keśapāśe taṃ bhrāmayāmāsa cāṃbaram .. 124 ..
17.18.d:
नरसिंहमथो दृष्ट्वा निपपात पुनः क्षितौ ..
विगृह्य केशपाशे तं भ्रामयामास चांबरम् .. 124 ..
17.18.m: Seeing Narasiṃha, he fell again to the ground. / Seizing him by his mass of hair, [the Lord] whirled him in the air.

17.18.s:
bhrāmayitvā śataguṇaṃ pṛthivyāṃ samapothayat ..
na mamāra sa daityendro brahmaṇo varakāraṇāt .. 125 ..
17.18.d:
भ्रामयित्वा शतगुणं पृथिव्यां समपोथयत् ..
न ममार स दैत्येन्द्रो ब्रह्मणो वरकारणात् .. 125 ..
17.18.m: Having whirled him a hundred times, he smashed him onto the earth; / yet that king of the Daityas did not die, on account of Brahmā's boon.

17.18.s:
gaganasthaistadā devai ruccaiḥ saṃsmārito hariḥ ..
daityaṃ jānuni cānīya vakṣo hṛṣṭo nirīkṣya ca .. 126 ..
17.18.d:
गगनस्थैस्तदा देवै रुच्चैः संस्मारितो हरिः ..
दैत्यं जानुनि चानीय वक्षो हृष्टो निरीक्ष्य च .. 126 ..
17.18.m: Then Hari was loudly reminded by the gods abiding in the sky; / placing the Daitya on his lap, joyful, and looking at his chest,

17.18.s:
jayajayeti yakṣānāṃ surāṇāṃ so'vadhārayat ..
śabdaṃ karṇe bhujau sajjau kṛtvā tau padmalāṃchitau .. 127 ..
17.18.d:
जयजयेति यक्षानां सुराणां सोऽवधारयत् ..
शब्दं कर्णे भुजौ सज्जौ कृत्वा तौ पद्मलांछितौ .. 127 ..
17.18.m: He perceived the sound of "Victory, victory!" of the yakṣas and the gods / in his ear, having readied his two arms marked with lotuses.

17.18.s:
bibheda vakṣo daityasya vajraghātakiṇāṃkitam..
nakhaiḥ kundasumaprakhyairasthisaṃghātakarśitam .. 128 ..
17.18.d:
बिभेद वक्षो दैत्यस्य वज्रघातकिणांकितम्..
नखैः कुन्दसुमप्रख्यैरस्थिसंघातकर्शितम् .. 128 ..
17.18.m: With his nails resembling jasmine flowers, he tore open the chest of the daitya, / which was scarred by the blows of thunderbolts, emaciated by the mass of bones.

17.18.s:
bhinne vakṣasi daityendro mamāraca papāta ca ..
tadā saharṣamabhavattrailokyaṃ sacarācaram.. 129 ..
17.18.d:
भिन्ने वक्षसि दैत्येन्द्रो ममारच पपात च ..
तदा सहर्षमभवत्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्.. 129 ..
17.18.m: When his chest was torn open, the lord of daityas died and fell down. / Then the three worlds, together with all moving and unmoving beings, were filled with joy.

17.18.s:
mamāpi tṛptiḥ sañjātā prasādāttava keśava..
yadā puratraye dagdhe prasādācchaṃkarasya ca .. 7.2.18.130 ..
17.18.d:
ममापि तृप्तिः सञ्जाता प्रसादात्तव केशव..
यदा पुरत्रये दग्धे प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च .. 7.2.18.130 ..
17.18.m: “I too obtained satisfaction by your grace, Keśava, / just as when the three cities were burned by the grace of Śaṃkara.

17.18.s:
hiṇyākṣe punarjātā sā kāle vinipātite ..
idānīṃ nāsti me tṛptiḥ kutra yāmi karomi kim.. 131 ..
17.18.d:
हिण्याक्षे पुनर्जाता सा काले विनिपातिते ..
इदानीं नास्ति मे तृप्तिः कुत्र यामि करोमि किम्.. 131 ..
17.18.m: It arose again when Hiraṇyākṣa was struck down in due time; / now I have no satisfaction—where shall I go, what shall I do?

17.18.s:
pṛthivyāṃ kṣatriyāḥ santi na yudhyaṃte parasparam..
devānāṃ dānavaiḥ sārddhaṃ nāsti yuddhaṃ kathaṃ prabho ..132..
17.18.d:
पृथिव्यां क्षत्रियाः सन्ति न युध्यंते परस्परम्..
देवानां दानवैः सार्द्धं नास्ति युद्धं कथं प्रभो ..132..
17.18.m: On earth the kṣatriyas do not fight with one another. / Why is there no battle of the gods with the dānavas, O Lord?

17.18.s:
idānīṃ balinā vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram..
pañcamo yo'vatāraste na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati ..
valinigrahakālo'yaṃ taddarśaya janārdana .. 133 ..
17.18.d:
इदानीं बलिना व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्..
पञ्चमो योऽवतारस्ते न जाने किं करिष्यति ..
वलिनिग्रहकालोऽयं तद्दर्शय जनार्दन .. 133 ..
17.18.m: Now the three worlds with the moving and unmoving beings are pervaded by Bali. / I do not know what your fifth incarnation will do. / This is the time for subduing Bali; therefore reveal it, O Janārdana.”

17.18.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
tadetatsakalaṃ śrutvā babhāṣe vāmano munim .. 134 ..
17.18.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
तदेतत्सकलं श्रुत्वा बभाषे वामनो मुनिम् .. 134 ..
17.18.m: Sārasvata said: / Having heard all this, Vāmana spoke to the sage.

17.18.s:
.. vāmana uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu nārada yadvṛttaṃ hiṇyakaśipau hate ..
daityarājaḥ kṛto rājā prahlādo'tīva vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 135 ..
17.18.d:
.. वामन उवाच .. ..
शृणु नारद यद्वृत्तं हिण्यकशिपौ हते ..
दैत्यराजः कृतो राजा प्रह्लादोऽतीव वैष्णवः .. 135 ..
17.18.m: Vāmana said: / Listen, Nārada, to what occurred when Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain: / Prahlāda, the great Vaiṣṇava, was made king of the daityas.

17.18.s:
tena rājyaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe kṛtaṃ saṃvatsarānbahūn..
tasyāpi kurvato rājyaṃ vigraho hi suraiḥ samam .. 136 ..
17.18.d:
तेन राज्यं धरापृष्ठे कृतं संवत्सरान्बहून्..
तस्यापि कुर्वतो राज्यं विग्रहो हि सुरैः समम् .. 136 ..
17.18.m: He ruled over the surface of the earth for many years. / Even while he ruled, indeed, a conflict with the gods

17.18.s:
no paśyāmyapi daityānāṃ pūrvavairamanusmaran..
utpādya putrānsabahūnrājyaṃ cakre sa puṣkalam..137..
17.18.d:
नो पश्याम्यपि दैत्यानां पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्..
उत्पाद्य पुत्रान्सबहून्राज्यं चक्रे स पुष्कलम्..137..
17.18.m: did not occur among the daityas, remembering their ancient enmity. / Having begotten many sons, he ruled the kingdom abundantly.

17.18.s:
virocanādbalirjāto bāla eva yadā'bhavat ..
ekānte sa hariṃ jñātvā tadā yogena kenacit .. 138 ..
17.18.d:
विरोचनाद्बलिर्जातो बाल एव यदाऽभवत् ..
एकान्ते स हरिं ज्ञात्वा तदा योगेन केनचित् .. 138 ..
17.18.m: When Bali was born from Virocana and was still a boy, / [Prahlāda], realizing Hari in secret through a certain yoga,

17.18.s:
muktvā rājyaṃ priyānputrāngato'sau girisānuṣu ..
kalpāntasthāyinaṃ dehaṃ tasya cakre janārddanaḥ .. 139 ..
17.18.d:
मुक्त्वा राज्यं प्रियान्पुत्रान्गतोऽसौ गिरिसानुषु ..
कल्पान्तस्थायिनं देहं तस्य चक्रे जनार्द्दनः .. 139 ..
17.18.m: abandoned his kingdom and beloved sons, and went to the mountain ridges. / Janārdana made his body endure until the end of the kalpa.

17.18.s:
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca bahūnāṃ rājyakāraṇe ..
vivādotīva saṃjātaḥ ko no rājā bhavediti .. 7.2.18.140 ..
17.18.d:
दैत्यानां दानवानां च बहूनां राज्यकारणे ..
विवादोतीव संजातः को नो राजा भवेदिति .. 7.2.18.140 ..
17.18.m: Among the many daityas and dānavas a great dispute arose / regarding the kingdom: "Who shall be our king?"

17.18.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
hiṇyākṣasya ye putrāḥ pautrāśca balavattarāḥ ..
virocanaprabhṛtayaḥ santi ye balavattarāḥ .. 141 ..
17.18.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
हिण्याक्षस्य ये पुत्राः पौत्राश्च बलवत्तराः ..
विरोचनप्रभृतयः सन्ति ये बलवत्तराः .. 141 ..
17.18.m: Nārada said: / The sons of Hiraṇyākṣa and his grandsons are very strong; / Virocana and the others are very powerful.

17.18.s:
vṛṣaparvāpi balavānrājyārthe samupasthitaḥ ..
indravitteśavaruṇā vāyuḥ sūryonalo yamaḥ .. 142 ..
17.18.d:
वृषपर्वापि बलवान्राज्यार्थे समुपस्थितः ..
इन्द्रवित्तेशवरुणा वायुः सूर्योनलो यमः .. 142 ..
17.18.m: Vṛṣaparvan also, being strong, presented himself for the sake of the kingdom. / Indra, Kubera, Varuṇa, Vāyu, Sūrya, Agni, and Yama

17.18.s:
daityena sadṛśā na syurbalarūpakṣamādibhiḥ ..
audāryādiguṇaiḥ kṛtvā santatyā cāsurādhikaḥ .. 143 ..
17.18.d:
दैत्येन सदृशा न स्युर्बलरूपक्षमादिभिः ..
औदार्यादिगुणैः कृत्वा सन्तत्या चासुराधिकः .. 143 ..
17.18.m: would not be equal to a daitya in strength, form, patience, and the like; / and by virtues such as generosity, and by offspring, he surpassed the asuras.

17.18.s:
śukreṇā cāryamāṇāste yuddhyaṃte ca parasparam..
amṛtāharaṇe dauṣṭyaṃ yadā daityāḥ smaranti tat ..144..
17.18.d:
शुक्रेणा चार्यमाणास्ते युद्ध्यंते च परस्परम्..
अमृताहरणे दौष्ट्यं यदा दैत्याः स्मरन्ति तत् ..144..
17.18.m: Being instructed by Śukra, they fight with one another. / When the daityas remember that wickedness at the stealing of the nectar—

17.18.s:
pītāvaśeṣamamṛtaṃ kasmādyacchaṃti devatāḥ ..
nāsmākamiti saṃnahya yudhyante ca parasparam .. 145 ..
17.18.d:
पीतावशेषममृतं कस्माद्यच्छंति देवताः ..
नास्माकमिति संनह्य युध्यन्ते च परस्परम् .. 145 ..
17.18.m: "Why do the gods not give us the remainder of the nectar that was drunk?"— / girding themselves thus, they fight with one another.

17.18.s:
kadācidapi no yuddhaṃ viśrāṃtimupagacchati ..
ekakāryodyatā yasmādbahavo daityadānavāḥ .. 146 ..
17.18.d:
कदाचिदपि नो युद्धं विश्रांतिमुपगच्छति ..
एककार्योद्यता यस्माद्बहवो दैत्यदानवाः .. 146 ..
17.18.m: Never at all does the battle find rest, / because the many daityas and dānavas are bent upon a single purpose.

17.18.s:
pītvā'mṛtaṃ surā jātā amarāste jayanti ca ..
devadānavadaityānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām ..
viṣṇurbalādhiko yuddhe tadetatkāraṇaṃ vada .. 147 .. ..
17.18.d:
पीत्वाऽमृतं सुरा जाता अमरास्ते जयन्ति च ..
देवदानवदैत्यानां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् ..
विष्णुर्बलाधिको युद्धे तदेतत्कारणं वद .. 147 .. ..
17.18.m: Having drunk the nectar, the gods became immortal and they conquer. / Tell this reason: why Viṣṇu is superior in strength in battle / over gods, dānavas, daityas, gandharvas, serpents, and rākṣasas.

17.18.s:
.. vāmana uvāca .. ..
anādinidhanaḥ karttā pātā harttā janārdanaḥ..
eko'yaṃ sa śivo devaḥ sa cāyaṃ brahmasaṃjñitaḥ ..
ekasya tu yadā kāryaṃ jāyate bhuvane nṛpa .. 148 ..
17.18.d:
.. वामन उवाच .. ..
अनादिनिधनः कर्त्ता पाता हर्त्ता जनार्दनः..
एकोऽयं स शिवो देवः स चायं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः ..
एकस्य तु यदा कार्यं जायते भुवने नृप .. 148 ..
17.18.m: Vāmana said: / Janārdana is without beginning or end, the creator, protector, and destroyer. / This one alone is the god Śiva, and he is designated as Brahman. / When a deed needs to be done for the one in the world, O king,

17.18.s:
tasya dehaṃ samāśritya mṛtyukāryaṃ kurvaṃti te ..
brahmāṃḍaṃ sakalaṃ viṣṇoḥ karadaṃ varado yataḥ ..
tasmādbalādhiko viṣṇurna tathānyo'sti kaścana .. 149 ..
17.18.d:
तस्य देहं समाश्रित्य मृत्युकार्यं कुर्वंति ते ..
ब्रह्मांडं सकलं विष्णोः करदं वरदो यतः ..
तस्माद्बलाधिको विष्णुर्न तथान्योऽस्ति कश्चन .. 149 ..
17.18.m: having resorted to his body, they perform the work of death. / The entire egg of Brahmā pays tribute to Viṣṇu, because he is the granter of boons; / therefore Viṣṇu is superior in strength, and none other is like him.

17.18.s:
pālanāyodyato viṣṇuḥ kimanyaiścarmacakṣubhiḥ ..
indrādyāśca surāḥ sarve viṣṇorvyāpārakāriṇaḥ .. 7.2.18.150 ..
17.18.d:
पालनायोद्यतो विष्णुः किमन्यैश्चर्मचक्षुभिः ..
इन्द्राद्याश्च सुराः सर्वे विष्णोर्व्यापारकारिणः .. 7.2.18.150 ..
17.18.m: Viṣṇu is intent upon protection; what use are others with their physical eyes? / Indra and all the other gods are performers of Viṣṇu's business.

17.18.s:
sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā tato brahmā kailāse saṃsthito haraḥ ..
na śakyate surairviṣṇurbhrāmyante bhuvanatraye .. 151 ..
17.18.d:
सृष्टिं कृत्वा ततो ब्रह्मा कैलासे संस्थितो हरः ..
न शक्यते सुरैर्विष्णुर्भ्राम्यन्ते भुवनत्रये .. 151 ..
17.18.m: Having performed creation, Brahmā then [rested]; Hara remained on Kailāsa. / Viṣṇu cannot be [controlled] by the gods; they wander about the three worlds.

17.18.s:
jagatyasminyadā kaścidvaiparītyena vartate ..
tasyocchedaṃ samāgatya karotyeva janārdanaḥ .. 152 ..
17.18.d:
जगत्यस्मिन्यदा कश्चिद्वैपरीत्येन वर्तते ..
तस्योच्छेदं समागत्य करोत्येव जनार्दनः .. 152 ..
17.18.m: Whenever someone acts contrarily in this world, / Janārdana approaches and destroys him indeed.

17.18.s:
tvamejaya mahābāho na mano nāradā'dayam ..
sarvapāpaharāṃ divyāṃ tāṃ kathāṃ kathayāmyaham .. 153 ..
17.18.d:
त्वमेजय महाबाहो न मनो नारदाऽदयम् ..
सर्वपापहरां दिव्यां तां कथां कथयाम्यहम् .. 153 ..
17.18.m: Do not be disheartened, O mighty-armed Nārada, in your mind; / I shall relate that divine story which takes away all sins.

17.18.s:
purā vivadatāṃ teṣāṃ daityānāṃ rājyahetave ..
prahlādena samāgatya vyavasthā vihitā svayam .. 154 ..
17.18.d:
पुरा विवदतां तेषां दैत्यानां राज्यहेतवे ..
प्रह्लादेन समागत्य व्यवस्था विहिता स्वयम् .. 154 ..
17.18.m: Formerly, while those daityas were disputing for the sake of the kingdom, / Prahlāda came and established the arrangement himself:

17.18.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃ panno dīrghāyurbalavattaraḥ ..
yajñaśīlaḥ sadānaṃdo bahuputrotidurjayaḥ .. 155 ..
17.18.d:
सर्वलक्षणसं पन्नो दीर्घायुर्बलवत्तरः ..
यज्ञशीलः सदानंदो बहुपुत्रोतिदुर्जयः .. 155 ..
17.18.m: “He who is endowed with all auspicious marks, long-lived, exceedingly strong, / devoted to sacrifice, ever joyful, having many sons, exceedingly invincible,

17.18.s:
na yudhyate suraiḥ sākaṃ viṣṇuṃ yo vetti durjayam ..
saṃgrāme maraṇaṃ nāsti yasya yaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ .. 156 ..
17.18.d:
न युध्यते सुरैः साकं विष्णुं यो वेत्ति दुर्जयम् ..
संग्रामे मरणं नास्ति यस्य यः सर्वदक्षिणः .. 156 ..
17.18.m: who does not fight with the gods, who knows Viṣṇu to be invincible, / who has no death in battle, who is completely generous,

17.18.s:
ātmano vacanaṃ vyarthaṃ na karoti kathaṃcana ..
sarveṣāṃ putrapautrāṇāṃ madhye yo rājate śriyā .. 157 ..
17.18.d:
आत्मनो वचनं व्यर्थं न करोति कथंचन ..
सर्वेषां पुत्रपौत्राणां मध्ये यो राजते श्रिया .. 157 ..
17.18.m: who never makes his own word in vain, / and who shines with splendor in the midst of all sons and grandsons,

17.18.s:
abhiṣiktastu śukreṇa sa vo rājā bhavediti ..
gurupramāṇamityuktvā yayau yatrāgataḥ punaḥ .. 158 ..
17.18.d:
अभिषिक्तस्तु शुक्रेण स वो राजा भवेदिति ..
गुरुप्रमाणमित्युक्त्वा ययौ यत्रागतः पुनः .. 158 ..
17.18.m: being consecrated by Śukra, he shall be your king.” / Having said, “The guru is the authority,” he departed to where he had come from.

17.18.s:
tathā ca kṛtavaṃtaste sahitā daityadānavāḥ ..
virocanaprabhṛtayaḥ putrāḥ pautrāḥ svayaṃgatāḥ .. 159 ..
17.18.d:
तथा च कृतवंतस्ते सहिता दैत्यदानवाः ..
विरोचनप्रभृतयः पुत्राः पौत्राः स्वयंगताः .. 159 ..
17.18.m: And so those daityas and dānavas together did so; / Virocana and the other sons and grandsons went in person.

17.18.s:
pratyekaṃ vīkṣitāḥ sarve guruṇā jñānapūrvakam ..
prahlādena guṇāḥ proktā na te saṃti virocane ..7.2.18.160..
17.18.d:
प्रत्येकं वीक्षिताः सर्वे गुरुणा ज्ञानपूर्वकम् ..
प्रह्लादेन गुणाः प्रोक्ता न ते संति विरोचने ..7.2.18.160..
17.18.m: Each one was examined by the guru with discernment; / the virtues spoken of by Prahlāda were not present in Virocana.

17.18.s:
anyeṣāmapi daityānāṃ vṛṣaparvāpi nedṛśaḥ ..
yathā nirīkṣitāḥ putrā baliprabhṛtayo mune ..
sarvānsaṃvīkṣya śukreṇa balau dṛṣṭā guṇāstathā .. 161 ..
17.18.d:
अन्येषामपि दैत्यानां वृषपर्वापि नेदृशः ..
यथा निरीक्षिताः पुत्रा बलिप्रभृतयो मुने ..
सर्वान्संवीक्ष्य शुक्रेण बलौ दृष्टा गुणास्तथा .. 161 ..
17.18.m: Nor were they found in the other daityas; even Vṛṣaparvan was not like that. / As the sons, Bali and the others, were examined, O sage, / when all were inspected by Śukra, those virtues were observed in Bali.

17.18.s:
balidehe'dhikāndṛṣṭvā daityebhyo viniveditāḥ ..
balirguṇādhiko daityāḥ kathaṃ kāryaṃ bhavenmayā .. 162 ..
17.18.d:
बलिदेहेऽधिकान्दृष्ट्वा दैत्येभ्यो विनिवेदिताः ..
बलिर्गुणाधिको दैत्याः कथं कार्यं भवेन्मया .. 162 ..
17.18.m: Seeing them abundant in Bali's body, they were announced to the daityas: / “Bali is superior in virtues, O daityas; what should I do?

17.18.s:
kenāpi daivayogena baliriṃdro bhaviṣyati ..
yādṛśastu pitā loke tādṛśastu suto bhavet .. 163 ..
17.18.d:
केनापि दैवयोगेन बलिरिंद्रो भविष्यति ..
यादृशस्तु पिता लोके तादृशस्तु सुतो भवेत् .. 163 ..
17.18.m: By some stroke of destiny Bali will become Indra. / Just as the father is in the world, so the son may be;

17.18.s:
pautraśca niścitaṃ tādṛgbhavatīti na cetsutaḥ ..
prahlādastu mahāyogī vaiṣṇavo viṣṇuvallabhaḥ .. 164 ..
17.18.d:
पौत्रश्च निश्चितं तादृग्भवतीति न चेत्सुतः ..
प्रह्लादस्तु महायोगी वैष्णवो विष्णुवल्लभः .. 164 ..
17.18.m: and the grandson certainly becomes like that, if not the son. / Prahlāda was a great yogin, a devotee of Viṣṇu, beloved of Viṣṇu.

17.18.s:
tasmādvirocane keciddhiraṇyakaśiporguṇāḥ ..
jyeṣṭho virocano rājye yadi cetkriyate'surāḥ ..
narasiṃhaḥ samāgatya niścitaṃ mārayiṣyati .. 165 ..
17.18.d:
तस्माद्विरोचने केचिद्धिरण्यकशिपोर्गुणाः ..
ज्येष्ठो विरोचनो राज्ये यदि चेत्क्रियतेऽसुराः ..
नरसिंहः समागत्य निश्चितं मारयिष्यति .. 165 ..
17.18.m: Therefore certain virtues of Hiraṇyakaśipu are in Virocana. / If the eldest, Virocana, is placed on the throne, O asuras, / Narasiṃha will surely come and kill him.”

17.18.s:
muktaṃ virocanenāpi rājyaṃ maraṇabhīruṇā ..
prahlādasya guṇāḥ sarve balidehe vyavasthitāḥ .. 166 ..
17.18.d:
मुक्तं विरोचनेनापि राज्यं मरणभीरुणा ..
प्रह्लादस्य गुणाः सर्वे बलिदेहे व्यवस्थिताः .. 166 ..
17.18.m: The kingdom was also relinquished by Virocana, who was afraid of death. / All the virtues of Prahlāda were established in Bali's body.

17.18.s:
evaṃ te samayaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ rājye'bhyaṣiṃcaya n ..
yaḥ prahlādaḥ sa vai viṣṇuryo viṣṇuḥ sa baliḥ svayam .. 167 ..
17.18.d:
एवं ते समयं कृत्वा बलिं राज्येऽभ्यषिंचय न् ..
यः प्रह्लादः स वै विष्णुर्यो विष्णुः स बलिः स्वयम् .. 167 ..
17.18.m: Thus, having made an agreement, they consecrated Bali in the kingdom. / He who is Prahlāda is indeed Viṣṇu, and he who is Viṣṇu is Bali himself.

17.18.s:
ato mitrīkṛto devairvigrahaistu vivarjitaḥ ..
ekībhāvaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ balirājye surāsuraiḥ .. 168 ..
17.18.d:
अतो मित्रीकृतो देवैर्विग्रहैस्तु विवर्जितः ..
एकीभावं कृतं सर्वं बलिराज्ये सुरासुरैः .. 168 ..
17.18.m: Therefore, he was befriended by the gods and freed from hostilities; / all gods and asuras made a union under Bali's rule.

17.18.s:
tasyāpi bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā deveṃdro mama maṃdire ..
samāgatā vālakhilyāḥ śaptohaṃ vāmanaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 169 ..
17.18.d:
तस्यापि भाषितं श्रुत्वा देवेंद्रो मम मंदिरे ..
समागता वालखिल्याः शप्तोहं वामनः कृतः .. 169 ..
17.18.m: Hearing his words too, the lord of gods [went] to my dwelling; / the Vālakhilyas arrived, and I was cursed and turned into a dwarf.

17.18.s:
prasādya te mayā proktāḥ śāpamuktipradā mama ..
bhaviṣyatīti tairuktaṃ balinigrahaṇādanu .. 7.2.18.170 ..
17.18.d:
प्रसाद्य ते मया प्रोक्ताः शापमुक्तिप्रदा मम ..
भविष्यतीति तैरुक्तं बलिनिग्रहणादनु .. 7.2.18.170 ..
17.18.m: Having propitiated them, I said, 'Grant me release from the curse.' / They said, 'It will take place after the subjugation of Bali.'

17.18.s:
tavāpi kautukaṃ yuddhe baliryajñaṃ karoti ca ..
devānāṃ nigraho nāsti sarve yajñe samāgatāḥ .. 171 ..
17.18.d:
तवापि कौतुकं युद्धे बलिर्यज्ञं करोति च ..
देवानां निग्रहो नास्ति सर्वे यज्ञे समागताः .. 171 ..
17.18.m: You too have an eager desire for battle, and Bali is performing a sacrifice; / there is no restraint placed on the gods; all have arrived at the sacrifice.

17.18.s:
sa māṃ yajati yajñena vadhaṃ tasya karotu kaḥ ..
ahaṃ ca vāmano jāto nāradaḥ kautukānvitaḥ .. 172 ..
17.18.d:
स मां यजति यज्ञेन वधं तस्य करोतु कः ..
अहं च वामनो जातो नारदः कौतुकान्वितः .. 172 ..
17.18.m: He worships me with the sacrifice; who would kill him? / And I have become a dwarf, while Nārada is filled with curious eagerness.

17.18.s:
viparītamidaṃ sarvaṃ varttate mama cetasi ..
tathā'pi kramayogena sarvaṃ bhavyaṃ karomyaham .. 173 ..
17.18.d:
विपरीतमिदं सर्वं वर्त्तते मम चेतसि ..
तथाऽपि क्रमयोगेन सर्वं भव्यं करोम्यहम् .. 173 ..
17.18.m: All this appears contradictory in my mind; / even so, in due course, I shall make everything turn out well."

17.18.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa yuddhārthaṃ kautukaṃ mama ..
ekena brāhmaṇenājau hanyaṃte kṣatriyā yadā ..
pitrā proktaṃ ca me pūrvaṃ tadā yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati..174..
17.18.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
प्रसादं कुरु देवेश युद्धार्थं कौतुकं मम ..
एकेन ब्राह्मणेनाजौ हन्यंते क्षत्रिया यदा ..
पित्रा प्रोक्तं च मे पूर्वं तदा युद्धं भविष्यति..174..
17.18.m: Nārada said: / "Be gracious, O Lord of Gods, for I have a curious desire for battle. / When kṣatriyas are slain in battle by a single brahmin, / as was previously told to me by my father, then battle shall take place.

17.18.s:
brāhmaṇosi bhavāñjātaḥ kadā yuddhaṃ kariṣyasi ..
vihasya vāmano brūte satyaṃ tava bhaviṣyati ..175..
17.18.d:
ब्राह्मणोसि भवाञ्जातः कदा युद्धं करिष्यसि ..
विहस्य वामनो ब्रूते सत्यं तव भविष्यति ..175..
17.18.m: You have been born as a brahmin; when will you wage battle?" / Laughing, the dwarf said, "Your [wish] shall come true.

17.18.s:
jamadagnisuto bhūtvā guruṃ kṛtvā maheśvaram..
kārttavīryaṃ vadhiṣyāmi bahubhiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ saha..176..
17.18.d:
जमदग्निसुतो भूत्वा गुरुं कृत्वा महेश्वरम्..
कार्त्तवीर्यं वधिष्यामि बहुभिः क्षत्रियैः सह..176..
17.18.m: Becoming the son of Jamadagni, having taken Maheśvara as my guru, / I will slay Kārttavīrya along with many kṣatriyas.

17.18.s:
samaṃtapaṃcake paṃca kariṣye rudhirahradān ..
tatrāhaṃ tarpayiṣyāmi pitṝnatha pitāmahān .. 177 ..
17.18.d:
समंतपंचके पंच करिष्ये रुधिरह्रदान् ..
तत्राहं तर्पयिष्यामि पितॄनथ पितामहान् .. 177 ..
17.18.m: At Samantapañcaka I will make five lakes of blood; / there I will offer oblations to my fathers and grandfathers.

17.18.s:
puṇyakṣetraṃ kariṣyāmi bhavāṃstatrāgamiṣya ti ..
paraṃ ca kautukaṃ yuddhe bhaviṣyati tava priyam .. 178 ..
17.18.d:
पुण्यक्षेत्रं करिष्यामि भवांस्तत्रागमिष्य ति ..
परं च कौतुकं युद्धे भविष्यति तव प्रियम् .. 178 ..
17.18.m: I will make it a sacred field; you will come there, / and an immense battle, delightful to you, shall be [fought] to your pleasure.

17.18.s:
brāhmaṇebhyo grahīṣyaṃti yadā kuṃ kṣatriyāḥ punaḥ ..
tadaiva tānhaniṣyāmi punardā syāmi medinīm .. 179 ..
17.18.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ग्रहीष्यंति यदा कुं क्षत्रियाः पुनः ..
तदैव तान्हनिष्यामि पुनर्दा स्यामि मेदिनीम् .. 179 ..
17.18.m: Whenever the kṣatriyas seize the earth again from the brahmins, / I will slay them right then and give back the earth.

17.18.s:
trisaptavāraṃ dāsyāmi jitvā jitvā vasuṃdharām ..
śastranyāsaṃ kariṣyāmi nirviṇṇo yuddhakarmaṇi ..
vihariṣyāmi ramyeṣu vaneṣu girisānuṣu .. 7.2.18.180 ..
17.18.d:
त्रिसप्तवारं दास्यामि जित्वा जित्वा वसुंधराम् ..
शस्त्रन्यासं करिष्यामि निर्विण्णो युद्धकर्मणि ..
विहरिष्यामि रम्येषु वनेषु गिरिसानुषु .. 7.2.18.180 ..
17.18.m: Three times seven times I will give away the earth, conquering it again and again. / Having laid down my weapons, weary of the acts of war, / I will wander happily in pleasant forests and mountain ridges.

17.18.s:
laṃkāyāṃ rāvaṇo rājyaṃ kariṣyati mahābalaḥ ..
trailokyakaṃṭakaṃ nāma yadāsau dhārayiṣyati .. 181 ..
17.18.d:
लंकायां रावणो राज्यं करिष्यति महाबलः ..
त्रैलोक्यकंटकं नाम यदासौ धारयिष्यति .. 181 ..
17.18.m: In Laṅkā the mighty Rāvaṇa will rule; / when he bears the name 'Thorn of the Three Worlds,'

17.18.s:
tadā dāśarathī rāmaḥ kausalyānaṃdavarddhanaḥ ..
bhaviṣye bhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ gamiṣye yajñamaṃḍape .. 182 ..
17.18.d:
तदा दाशरथी रामः कौसल्यानंदवर्द्धनः ..
भविष्ये भ्रातृभिः सार्द्धं गमिष्ये यज्ञमंडपे .. 182 ..
17.18.m: then I will become Rāma, son of Daśaratha, increaser of Kauśalyā's joy; / together with my brothers I will go to the sacrificial hall.

17.18.s:
tāḍakāṃ tāḍayitvāhaṃ subāhuṃ yajñamaṃdire ..
nītvā yajñādgamiṣyāmi sītāyāstu svayaṃvare .. 183 ..
17.18.d:
ताडकां ताडयित्वाहं सुबाहुं यज्ञमंदिरे ..
नीत्वा यज्ञाद्गमिष्यामि सीतायास्तु स्वयंवरे .. 183 ..
17.18.m: Striking down Tāḍakā and Subāhu in the sacrificial pavilion, / departing from the sacrifice, I will go to Sītā's svayaṃvara.

17.18.s:
pariṇeṣyābhi tāṃ sītāṃ bhaṃktvā māheśvaraṃ dhanuḥ ..
tyaktvā rājyaṃ gamiṣyāmi vane varṣāṃścaturdaśa .. 184 ..
17.18.d:
परिणेष्याभि तां सीतां भंक्त्वा माहेश्वरं धनुः ..
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं गमिष्यामि वने वर्षांश्चतुर्दश .. 184 ..
17.18.m: Breaking Maheśvara's bow, I will marry Sītā; / abandoning the kingdom, I will go to the forest for fourteen years.

17.18.s:
sītāharaṇajaṃ duḥkhaṃ prathamaṃ me bhaviṣyati ..
nāsākarṇavihīnāṃ tāṃ kariṣye rākṣasīṃ vane .. 185 ..
17.18.d:
सीताहरणजं दुःखं प्रथमं मे भविष्यति ..
नासाकर्णविहीनां तां करिष्ये राक्षसीं वने .. 185 ..
17.18.m: The sorrow born of the abduction of Sītā will first befall me; / I will make that rākṣasa woman in the forest deprived of nose and ears.

17.18.s:
caturddaśasahasrāṇi triśiraḥkharadūṣaṇān ..
dhatvā haniṣye mārīcaṃ rākṣasaṃ mṛgarūpiṇam ..186..
17.18.d:
चतुर्द्दशसहस्राणि त्रिशिरःखरदूषणान् ..
धत्वा हनिष्ये मारीचं राक्षसं मृगरूपिणम् ..186..
17.18.m: Having slain the fourteen thousand [demons], Triśiras, Khara, and Dūṣaṇa, / I will slay the rākṣasa Mārīca who has taken the form of a deer.

17.18.s:
hṛtadāro gamiṣyāmi dagdhvā gṛdhraṃ jaṭāyuṣam ..
sugrīveṇa samaṃ maitrīṃ kṛtvā hatvā'tha vālinam .. 187 ..
17.18.d:
हृतदारो गमिष्यामि दग्ध्वा गृध्रं जटायुषम् ..
सुग्रीवेण समं मैत्रीं कृत्वा हत्वाऽथ वालिनम् .. 187 ..
17.18.m: Bereft of my wife, having cremated the vulture Jaṭāyu, I will proceed; / forming a friendship with Sugrīva, and then killing Vālin,

17.18.s:
samudraṃ baṃdhayiṣyāmi nalapramukhavānaraiḥ ..
laṃkāṃ saṃveṣṭayiṣyāmi mārayiṣyāmi rākṣasān .. 188 ..
17.18.d:
समुद्रं बंधयिष्यामि नलप्रमुखवानरैः ..
लंकां संवेष्टयिष्यामि मारयिष्यामि राक्षसान् .. 188 ..
17.18.m: I will have the ocean bridged by the monkeys headed by Nala; / I will surround Laṅkā and slay the rākṣasas.

17.18.s:
kumbhakarṇaṃ nihatyājau meghanādaṃ tato raṇe ..
nihatya rāvaṇaṃ rakṣaḥ paśyatāṃ sarvarakṣasām .. 189 ..
17.18.d:
कुम्भकर्णं निहत्याजौ मेघनादं ततो रणे ..
निहत्य रावणं रक्षः पश्यतां सर्वरक्षसाम् .. 189 ..
17.18.m: Having killed Kumbhakarṇa in combat, and then Meghanāda in battle, / [and] slaying the rākṣasa Rāvaṇa before the eyes of all the rākṣasas,

17.18.s:
vibhīṣaṇāya dāsyāmi laṃkāṃ devavinirmitām..
ayodhyāṃ punarāgatya kṛtvā rājyamakaṃṭakam ..7.2.18.190..
17.18.d:
विभीषणाय दास्यामि लंकां देवविनिर्मिताम्..
अयोध्यां पुनरागत्य कृत्वा राज्यमकंटकम् ..7.2.18.190..
17.18.m: I will give Laṅkā, fashioned by the gods, to Vibhīṣaṇa; / returning again to Ayodhyā, making the kingdom free of thorns,

17.18.s:
kāladurvāsasościtracaritreṇāmarāvatīm ..
yāsyehaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ putre nivedya ca ..191..
17.18.d:
कालदुर्वाससोश्चित्रचरित्रेणामरावतीम् ..
यास्येहं भ्रातृभिः सार्द्धं राज्यं पुत्रे निवेद्य च ..191..
17.18.m: by the wondrous conduct of Kāla and Durvāsas, / I will go to Amarāvatī with my brothers, having entrusted the kingdom to my son.

17.18.s:
dvāpare samanuprāpte kṣatriyairbahubhirmahī..
bhārākrāṃtā na śaknoti pātālaṃ gaṃtumudyatā ..192..
17.18.d:
द्वापरे समनुप्राप्ते क्षत्रियैर्बहुभिर्मही..
भाराक्रांता न शक्नोति पातालं गंतुमुद्यता ..192..
17.18.m: When the Dvāpara age arrives, the earth, / burdened by many kṣatriyas and unable [to bear it], will prepare to sink down to Pātāla.

17.18.s:
mathurāyāṃ tadā karttā kaṃso rājyaṃ mahāsuraḥ ..
śiśupālajarāsaṃdhau kālanemirmahāsuraḥ .. 193 ..
17.18.d:
मथुरायां तदा कर्त्ता कंसो राज्यं महासुरः ..
शिशुपालजरासंधौ कालनेमिर्महासुरः .. 193 ..
17.18.m: In Mathurā at that time the great asura Kaṃsa will rule; / [and there will be] Śiśupāla, Jarāsandha, and the great asura Kālanemi,

17.18.s:
pauṃḍrako vāsudevaśca bāṇo rājā mahāsuraḥ ..
gajavājituraṃgāḍhyā vadhyaṃte me tadā mune .. 194 ..
17.18.d:
पौंड्रको वासुदेवश्च बाणो राजा महासुरः ..
गजवाजितुरंगाढ्या वध्यंते मे तदा मुने .. 194 ..
17.18.m: Pauṇḍraka Vāsudeva, and King Bāṇa, a great asura; / abundant in elephants and horses, they will be slain by me then, O sage.

17.18.s:
kalau svalpodakā meghā alpadugdhāśca dhenavaḥ ..
dugdhe ghṛtaṃ na caivāsti nāsti satyaṃ janeṣu ca .. 195 ..
17.18.d:
कलौ स्वल्पोदका मेघा अल्पदुग्धाश्च धेनवः ..
दुग्धे घृतं न चैवास्ति नास्ति सत्यं जनेषु च .. 195 ..
17.18.m: In the Kali age, clouds will have little water, and cows will have little milk; / there will be no clarified butter in the milk, and no truth among people.

17.18.s:
corairupahatā lokā vyādhibhiḥ paripīḍitāḥ ..
trātāraṃ nābhi gacchaṃti yuddhāvasthāṃ gatā api .. 196 ..
17.18.d:
चोरैरुपहता लोका व्याधिभिः परिपीडिताः ..
त्रातारं नाभि गच्छंति युद्धावस्थां गता अपि .. 196 ..
17.18.m: People will be ruined by thieves and afflicted by diseases; / even when reduced to a state of conflict, they will find no protector.

17.18.s:
kṣudrāḥ paścimavāhinyo nadyaḥ śuṣyaṃti kārttike ..
ekādaśīvrataṃ nāsti kṛṣṇā yā ca caturddaśī ..197..
17.18.d:
क्षुद्राः पश्चिमवाहिन्यो नद्यः शुष्यंति कार्त्तिके ..
एकादशीव्रतं नास्ति कृष्णा या च चतुर्द्दशी ..197..
17.18.m: The small rivers flowing westward will dry up in Kārttika; / there will be no observance of Ekādaśī, nor of the dark Caturdaśī.

17.18.s:
na jānāti janaḥ kaścidvikrāṃtamapi sve gṛhe ..
daridropahataṃ sarvaṃ saṃdhyāsnānavivarjitam ..
bhaviṣyati kalau sarvaṃ na tatpūrvayugatraye .. 198 ..
17.18.d:
न जानाति जनः कश्चिद्विक्रांतमपि स्वे गृहे ..
दरिद्रोपहतं सर्वं संध्यास्नानविवर्जितम् ..
भविष्यति कलौ सर्वं न तत्पूर्वयुगत्रये .. 198 ..
17.18.m: No man will recognize valor even in his own home; / everything will be ruined by poverty and devoid of twilight prayers and ritual ablution; / all this will occur in the Kali age, not in the previous three ages.

17.18.s:
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ putrastyaktvā bhāryāṃ niṣevate ..
na guruḥ svajanaḥ kaścitko'pi kaṃ nānusevate .. 199 ..
17.18.d:
पितरं मातरं पुत्रस्त्यक्त्वा भार्यां निषेवते ..
न गुरुः स्वजनः कश्चित्कोऽपि कं नानुसेवते .. 199 ..
17.18.m: The son will abandon his father and mother and attend only to his wife; / there will be no teacher or kinsman; no one will serve anyone else.

17.18.s:
yathāyathā kalirvyāptiṃ karoti dharaṇītale ..
tathātathā janaḥ sarva ekākāro bhaviṣyati .. 7.2.18.200 ..
17.18.d:
यथायथा कलिर्व्याप्तिं करोति धरणीतले ..
तथातथा जनः सर्व एकाकारो भविष्यति .. 7.2.18.200 ..
17.18.m: In whatever measure the Kali age pervades the surface of the earth, / in that same measure all people will become uniform [in degradation].

17.18.s:
mlecchairupahataṃ sarvaṃ saṃdhyāsnānavivarjitam..
kalkirityabhivikhyāto bhaviṣye brāhmaṇo hyaham ..201..
17.18.d:
म्लेच्छैरुपहतं सर्वं संध्यास्नानविवर्जितम्..
कल्किरित्यभिविख्यातो भविष्ये ब्राह्मणो ह्यहम् ..201..
17.18.m: Everything will be ruined by mlecchas, bereft of twilight prayers and ritual ablution; / I will indeed become a brahmin renowned as Kalki.

17.18.s:
mlecchānāṃ chedanaṃ kṛtvā yājñavalyapurohitaḥ ..
bahusvarṇena yajñena yakṣye niṣkṛtikāraṇāt .. 202 ..
17.18.d:
म्लेच्छानां छेदनं कृत्वा याज्ञवल्यपुरोहितः ..
बहुस्वर्णेन यज्ञेन यक्ष्ये निष्कृतिकारणात् .. 202 ..
17.18.m: Cutting down the mlecchas, with Yājñavalkya as my priest, / I will sacrifice with a sacrifice rich in gold for the sake of expiation.

17.18.s:
bhaviṣyaṃtyavatārā me yuddhaṃ teṣu bhaviṣyati ..
idānīṃ balinā yuddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti na devatāḥ .. 203 ..
17.18.d:
भविष्यंत्यवतारा मे युद्धं तेषु भविष्यति ..
इदानीं बलिना युद्धं करिष्यंति न देवताः .. 203 ..
17.18.m: These incarnations of mine will come to pass; battle will be found in them; / at present the deities will not wage war with Bali.

17.18.s:
sa māṃ yajati daityendro na me vadhyo balirbhavet ..
sarvasvadānaniyamaṃ karoti sa mahādhvare .. .. 204 ..
17.18.d:
स मां यजति दैत्येन्द्रो न मे वध्यो बलिर्भवेत् ..
सर्वस्वदाननियमं करोति स महाध्वरे .. .. 204 ..
17.18.m: That lord of the daityas worships me; Bali must not be killed by me; / he undertakes the vow of giving away all his wealth at the great sacrifice."

17.18.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā nāradaṃ devo visṛjya tamathābhyagāt ..
draṣṭuṃ balikṛtaṃ yajñaṃ devakāryaprasiddhaye .. 205 ..
17.18.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा नारदं देवो विसृज्य तमथाभ्यगात् ..
द्रष्टुं बलिकृतं यज्ञं देवकार्यप्रसिद्धये .. 205 ..
17.18.m: Sārasvata said: / Having spoken thus to Nārada and dismissed him, the god then went / to see the sacrifice performed by Bali for the accomplishment of the divine purpose.

17.18.s:
vāmano nagaraṃ gatvā vīkṣamāṇo gṛhādgṛham ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhaṃ gatvā bhojanaṃ sa tu yācate .. 206 ..
17.18.d:
वामनो नगरं गत्वा वीक्षमाणो गृहाद्गृहम् ..
ब्राह्मणानां गृहं गत्वा भोजनं स तु याचते .. 206 ..
17.18.m: Going to the city and looking around from house to house, / the dwarf went to the houses of brahmins and begged for food.

17.18.s:
nityaṃ snānaparo vipro vedādhyayanatatparaḥ ..
vāmano labhate bhikṣāṃ bhojanaṃ dvijamaṃdire .. 207 ..
17.18.d:
नित्यं स्नानपरो विप्रो वेदाध्ययनतत्परः ..
वामनो लभते भिक्षां भोजनं द्विजमंदिरे .. 207 ..
17.18.m: Devoted to daily ritual ablution and engaged in Vedic recitation, / the dwarf brahmin received alms and food in the dwellings of the twice-born.

17.18.s:
catuṣpatheṣu ramyeṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ..
āste parivṛto lokaiścālayanvipulāṃ kaṭim .. 208 ..
17.18.d:
चतुष्पथेषु रम्येषु देवतायतनेषु च ..
आस्ते परिवृतो लोकैश्चालयन्विपुलां कटिम् .. 208 ..
17.18.m: At delightful crossroads and in temples of deities, / he sat surrounded by people, swaying his wide hips.

17.18.s:
śiro vidhūnate sthūlaṃ sthūlaskandho mahāhanuḥ ..
nṛtyate tālamānena gāyatyatimanoharam.. 209 ..
17.18.d:
शिरो विधूनते स्थूलं स्थूलस्कन्धो महाहनुः ..
नृत्यते तालमानेन गायत्यतिमनोहरम्.. 209 ..
17.18.m: He shook his thick head, with broad shoulders and a large jaw; / he danced in time to the rhythm and sang most enchantingly.

17.18.s:
vedānadhīte caturo vāmano dvijasaṃsadi ..
daityānāṃ tanayāḥ sarve brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 7.2.18.210 ..
17.18.d:
वेदानधीते चतुरो वामनो द्विजसंसदि ..
दैत्यानां तनयाः सर्वे ब्राह्मणानां तथैव च .. 7.2.18.210 ..
17.18.m: The dwarf studied the four Vedas in the assembly of twice-born; / all the sons of the Daityas, and likewise those of the brahmins,

17.18.s:
vāmanaṃ paryupāsaṃte divārātraṃ manoramam ..
atha taiḥ sakalairnīto vāmano yajñamaṃḍape .. 211 ..
17.18.d:
वामनं पर्युपासंते दिवारात्रं मनोरमम् ..
अथ तैः सकलैर्नीतो वामनो यज्ञमंडपे .. 211 ..
17.18.m: waited upon the charming dwarf day and night. / Then he, the dwarf, was led by all of them to the sacrificial pavilion.

17.18.s:
niścitaṃ maṭhikāsthānaṃ yācitavyo balistvayā ..
tadāsmākaṃ mahacchreyo deśasya nagarasya ca .. 212 ..
17.18.d:
निश्चितं मठिकास्थानं याचितव्यो बलिस्त्वया ..
तदास्माकं महच्छ्रेयो देशस्य नगरस्य च .. 212 ..
17.18.m: "You must ask Bali for a definite site for a hermitage; / then great welfare will come to us, to the country, and to the city."

17.18.s:
vijñapto vāmanaḥ sarvairdaityadvijakumārakaiḥ ..
vāmana vastavyaṃ daityeṃdranagare sadā .. 213 ..
17.18.d:
विज्ञप्तो वामनः सर्वैर्दैत्यद्विजकुमारकैः ..
वामन वस्तव्यं दैत्येंद्रनगरे सदा .. 213 ..
17.18.m: The dwarf was thus petitioned by all the young Daityas and brahmins: / "O dwarf, you must reside forever in the city of the king of Daityas."

17.18.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
praviveśa tathetyuktvā vāmano yajñamaṃḍape ..
tataḥ kolāhalo jāto dvāḥsthairdvāri kṛto mahān.. 214 ..
17.18.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
प्रविवेश तथेत्युक्त्वा वामनो यज्ञमंडपे ..
ततः कोलाहलो जातो द्वाःस्थैर्द्वारि कृतो महान्.. 214 ..
17.18.m: Sārasvata said: / Having said, "So be it," the dwarf entered the sacrificial pavilion; / then a great clamour arose, raised at the door by the doorkeepers.

17.18.s:
brāhmaṇairbahubhiḥ sārddhaṃ vedānuccārayansthitaḥ ..
tato vedadhvanirjāto mahānvai yajñamaṃḍapre .. 215 ..
17.18.d:
ब्राह्मणैर्बहुभिः सार्द्धं वेदानुच्चारयन्स्थितः ..
ततो वेदध्वनिर्जातो महान्वै यज्ञमंडप्रे .. 215 ..
17.18.m: Standing with many brahmins, he chanted the Vedas; / then a great Vedic sound indeed arose in the sacrificial pavilion.

17.18.s:
praviṣṭau prathamaṃ daityau daityāya viniveditaḥ ..
draṣṭuṃ samāgato deva brāhmaṇo vāmano'dhvare .. 216 ..
17.18.d:
प्रविष्टौ प्रथमं दैत्यौ दैत्याय विनिवेदितः ..
द्रष्टुं समागतो देव ब्राह्मणो वामनोऽध्वरे .. 216 ..
17.18.m: Two Daityas entered first and reported to the Daitya [king]: / "O king, a brahmin dwarf has arrived at the sacrifice to see

17.18.s:
bhavaṃtaṃ kautukāttāvaddvāradeśe samāviśat ..
eka eva yathāyāti vāmanastava sannidhau .. 217 ..
17.18.d:
भवंतं कौतुकात्तावद्द्वारदेशे समाविशत् ..
एक एव यथायाति वामनस्तव सन्निधौ .. 217 ..
17.18.m: Your Majesty out of curiosity; he has entered the doorway, / so that the dwarf comes alone into your presence.

17.18.s:
nirīho vāmano deva yāvattatraiva kiṃcana ..
vedānāṃ tu dhvaniṃ kṛtvā caturṇāmekavaktrataḥ .. 218 ..
17.18.d:
निरीहो वामनो देव यावत्तत्रैव किंचन ..
वेदानां तु ध्वनिं कृत्वा चतुर्णामेकवक्त्रतः .. 218 ..
17.18.m: The dwarf is free of desire, O lord, as long as [he remains] there; / yet he made the sound of the four Vedas from a single mouth."

17.18.s:
balirhṛṣṭo'bravīdvākyaṃ dvāḥsthamenaṃ praveśaya ..
pūjayiṣyāmi vipredraṃ dāsye cāsya yadīpsitam ..219..
17.18.d:
बलिर्हृष्टोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं द्वाःस्थमेनं प्रवेशय ..
पूजयिष्यामि विप्रेद्रं दास्ये चास्य यदीप्सितम् ..219..
17.18.m: Delighted, Bali said to the doorkeeper: "Bring him in; / I shall honour the best of brahmins and give him whatever he desires.

17.18.s:
smarāmi smṛtivākyāni yāni prāha gururmama ..
kiṃcidvedamayaṃ pātraṃ kiṃcitpātraṃ tapomayam.. 7.2.18.220 ..
17.18.d:
स्मरामि स्मृतिवाक्यानि यानि प्राह गुरुर्मम ..
किंचिद्वेदमयं पात्रं किंचित्पात्रं तपोमयम्.. 7.2.18.220 ..
17.18.m: I remember the sayings of the scriptures which my teacher spoke: / 'A worthy recipient is partly of Vedic nature, a worthy recipient is partly made of austerity;

17.18.s:
āgamiṣyati yatpātraṃ tatpātraṃ tārayiṣyati ..
yajñe pravarttamāne tu dātavyā dakṣiṇā mayā ..221..
17.18.d:
आगमिष्यति यत्पात्रं तत्पात्रं तारयिष्यति ..
यज्ञे प्रवर्त्तमाने तु दातव्या दक्षिणा मया ..221..
17.18.m: whichever recipient approaches, that recipient will deliver [the giver]. / While the sacrifice is proceeding, sacrificial gifts must be given by me.

17.18.s:
vāmano na vicāryastu satyamastu vaco mama ..
iti śrutvā guruḥ śukro vārayāmāsa taṃ balim.. 222 ..
17.18.d:
वामनो न विचार्यस्तु सत्यमस्तु वचो मम ..
इति श्रुत्वा गुरुः शुक्रो वारयामास तं बलिम्.. 222 ..
17.18.m: A dwarf must not be scrutinised; let my word be true.'" / Hearing this, his teacher Śukra restrained that Bali.

17.18.s:
śukra uvāca .. ..
dvāri pūjyā dvijāḥ saveṃ dīnāṃdha kṛpaṇādayaḥ ..
badhirā vāmanāḥ kubjā rogiṇo ye tu niṣṭhurāḥ ..223..
17.18.d:
शुक्र उवाच .. ..
द्वारि पूज्या द्विजाः सवें दीनांध कृपणादयः ..
बधिरा वामनाः कुब्जा रोगिणो ये तु निष्ठुराः ..223..
17.18.m: Śukra said: / "All brahmins are to be honoured at the door: the poor, the blind, the wretched, and others, / the deaf, dwarves, hunchbacks, those who are diseased, and those who are harsh.

17.18.s:
suvarṇarajatairvastrairvāmano dvāri pūjyatām ..
caturṇāṃ tu vṛthā janma vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa .. 224 ..
17.18.d:
सुवर्णरजतैर्वस्त्रैर्वामनो द्वारि पूज्यताम् ..
चतुर्णां तु वृथा जन्म वृथा दानानि षोडश .. 224 ..
17.18.m: Let the dwarf be honoured at the door with gold, silver, and garments. / The birth of four is useless, and sixteen gifts are useless:

17.18.s:
aputrāṇāṃ vṛthā janma ye ca dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ ..
parapākaṃ ca yeśnaṃti paradāraratāśca ye ..225..
17.18.d:
अपुत्राणां वृथा जन्म ये च धर्मबहिष्कृताः ..
परपाकं च येश्नंति परदाररताश्च ये ..225..
17.18.m: The birth of the sonless is useless, and of those excluded from dharma, / and those who eat another's cooked food, and those devoted to others' wives.

17.18.s:
anyāyenārjitaṃ vittaṃ na deyaṃ śreya icchatā ..
vyarthamabrāhmaṇe dānamārūḍhapatite tathā ..226..
17.18.d:
अन्यायेनार्जितं वित्तं न देयं श्रेय इच्छता ..
व्यर्थमब्राह्मणे दानमारूढपतिते तथा ..226..
17.18.m: Wealth acquired unjustly should not be given by one desiring welfare. / A gift to a non-brahmin is futile, and likewise to an apostate ascetic;

17.18.s:
saṃdhyāhīne dvije naṣṭe patite taskare tathā ..
guroścāprītijanake pitṛmātṛparāṅmukhe .. .. 227 ..
17.18.d:
संध्याहीने द्विजे नष्टे पतिते तस्करे तथा ..
गुरोश्चाप्रीतिजनके पितृमातृपराङ्मुखे .. .. 227 ..
17.18.m: to a brahmin destitute of twilight prayers, a degenerate, a fallen man, and likewise a thief; / to one who displeases his teacher, and one averse to his parents;

17.18.s:
brahmabandhau ca yaddataṃ yaddattaṃ vṛṣalīpatau ..
vedavikrayake caiva kṛtaghne grāmayājake .. 228 ..
17.18.d:
ब्रह्मबन्धौ च यद्दतं यद्दत्तं वृषलीपतौ ..
वेदविक्रयके चैव कृतघ्ने ग्रामयाजके .. 228 ..
17.18.m: what is given to a nominal brahmin, and what is given to the husband of a Śūdra woman; / to a seller of the Veda, an ungrateful person, and a priest who sacrifices for an entire village;

17.18.s:
strīnirjite ca yaddattaṃ vyālagrāhe tathaiva ca ..
parivāreṣu yaddattaṃ vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa .. 229 ..
17.18.d:
स्त्रीनिर्जिते च यद्दत्तं व्यालग्राहे तथैव च ..
परिवारेषु यद्दत्तं वृथा दानानि षोडश .. 229 ..
17.18.m: what is given to one dominated by a woman, and likewise to a snake-catcher, / and what is given to dependents—these sixteen gifts are useless."

17.18.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
atrāṃtare balirbrūte naivaṃ vācyaṃ tvayā guro ..
vedānadhīte yaḥ kaścitsa me viṣṇuḥ samāgataḥ .. 7.2.18.230 ..
17.18.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
अत्रांतरे बलिर्ब्रूते नैवं वाच्यं त्वया गुरो ..
वेदानधीते यः कश्चित्स मे विष्णुः समागतः .. 7.2.18.230 ..
17.18.m: Sārasvata said: / Meanwhile, Bali said: "You must not speak thus, O teacher! / Whoever recites the Vedas is Viṣṇu himself come to me.

17.18.s:
na vilaṃbastu karttavyaḥ śrotriye gṛhamāgate ..
abhyutthānena vacasā pādaprakṣālanena ca .. 231 ..
17.18.d:
न विलंबस्तु कर्त्तव्यः श्रोत्रिये गृहमागते ..
अभ्युत्थानेन वचसा पादप्रक्षालनेन च .. 231 ..
17.18.m: No delay must be made when a Vedic scholar has come to the house, / [honouring him] with rising up, with words, and with washing his feet;

17.18.s:
yathā śaktyā pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ gṛhamedhinā ..
apūjito yadā yāti vāmano maṃḍapādbahiḥ .. 232 ..
17.18.d:
यथा शक्त्या प्रदातव्यं भोजनं गृहमेधिना ..
अपूजितो यदा याति वामनो मंडपाद्बहिः .. 232 ..
17.18.m: food should be given according to ability by a householder. / When an unhonoured dwarf departs from the pavilion,

17.18.s:
tadāyaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti yajñaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ ..
atrāṃtare samānīto vāmano balisaṃnidhau .. 233 ..
17.18.d:
तदायं व्यर्थतां याति यज्ञः सर्वस्वदक्षिणः ..
अत्रांतरे समानीतो वामनो बलिसंनिधौ .. 233 ..
17.18.m: then this sacrifice, whose fee was one's entire property, becomes useless." / Meanwhile, the dwarf was brought into Bali's presence.

17.18.s:
āyāṃtaṃ dadṛśe daityo vāmanaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam ..
jājvalyamānaṃ vapuṣā piṃgalaṃ sūryasaṃnibham ..234..
17.18.d:
आयांतं ददृशे दैत्यो वामनं विष्णुरूपिणम् ..
जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा पिंगलं सूर्यसंनिभम् ..234..
17.18.m: The Daitya saw the approaching dwarf in the form of Viṣṇu, / blazing with his body, tawny, resembling the sun.

17.18.s:
utthāyābhimukhaḥ prāyānnamaskṛtyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ ..
dhanyo'haṃ yasya me yajñe prāpto viṣṇusamo dvijaḥ .. 235 ..
17.18.d:
उत्थायाभिमुखः प्रायान्नमस्कृत्याग्रतः स्थितः ..
धन्योऽहं यस्य मे यज्ञे प्राप्तो विष्णुसमो द्विजः .. 235 ..
17.18.m: Rising, he went toward him, bowed, and stood before him: / "Blessed am I, at whose sacrifice a brahmin equal to Viṣṇu has arrived!"

17.18.s:
vedimadhye samānīto dadau tasyāsanaṃ baliḥ ..
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvārghyaṃ viṣṭaraṃ baliḥ ..
śrīkhaṃḍagaṃdhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayitvāgrataḥ sthitaḥ .. 236 ..
17.18.d:
वेदिमध्ये समानीतो ददौ तस्यासनं बलिः ..
पाद्यमाचमनीयं च दत्त्वार्घ्यं विष्टरं बलिः ..
श्रीखंडगंधपुष्पाद्यैः पूजयित्वाग्रतः स्थितः .. 236 ..
17.18.m: Brought into the middle of the sacrificial altar, Bali offered him a seat; / having offered water for washing the feet, water for sipping, the guest offering, and a seat of grass, / and having honoured him with sandalwood, fragrance, flowers, and the like, Bali stood before him.

17.18.s:
madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ tasmai satvaraṃ sa nivedya ca ..
āghrāte madhuparke ca vāmanena tataḥ param .. 237 ..
17.18.d:
मधुपर्कं च गां तस्मै सत्वरं स निवेद्य च ..
आघ्राते मधुपर्के च वामनेन ततः परम् .. 237 ..
17.18.m: Having quickly offered him the honey-mixture and a cow, / and after the honey-mixture was smelled by the dwarf,

17.18.s:
svāgataṃ balinā proktaṃ svastītyuktaṃ dvijanmanā ..
ahamarthī samāyāto dīyatāṃ vada kiṃ vibho .. 238 ..
17.18.d:
स्वागतं बलिना प्रोक्तं स्वस्तीत्युक्तं द्विजन्मना ..
अहमर्थी समायातो दीयतां वद किं विभो .. 238 ..
17.18.m: Bali said, "Welcome!" The twice-born said, "Hail!" / "I have come as a petitioner; say, O lord, what should be given?"

17.18.s:
medinīṃ dehi me daitya kiyanmātrāṃ dvijottama ..
vāsārthaṃ mama daityendra dīyatāṃ me krama trayam .. 239 ..
17.18.d:
मेदिनीं देहि मे दैत्य कियन्मात्रां द्विजोत्तम ..
वासार्थं मम दैत्येन्द्र दीयतां मे क्रम त्रयम् .. 239 ..
17.18.m: "Give me land, O Daitya." "How much, O best of brahmins?" / "For my dwelling, O king of Daityas, let three paces be given to me;

17.18.s:
vidhāya maṭhikāṃ divyāṃ śiṣyānadhyāpayāmyaham ..
dattaṃ kramatrayaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhītaṃ vāmano'bravīt .. 7.2.18.240 ..
17.18.d:
विधाय मठिकां दिव्यां शिष्यानध्यापयाम्यहम् ..
दत्तं क्रमत्रयं तुभ्यं गृहीतं वामनोऽब्रवीत् .. 7.2.18.240 ..
17.18.m: having built a divine hermitage, I shall teach my students." / "Three paces are given to you." "Accepted," said the dwarf.

17.18.s:
mā dehītyavadacchukro viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ ..
hṛṣṭo brūte baliḥ śukraṃ pātraṃ syātkimataḥ param .. 241 ..
17.18.d:
मा देहीत्यवदच्छुक्रो विष्णुरेव सनातनः ..
हृष्टो ब्रूते बलिः शुक्रं पात्रं स्यात्किमतः परम् .. 241 ..
17.18.m: "Do not give!" said Śukra, "He is none other than the eternal Viṣṇu!" / Delighted, Bali said to Śukra: "What recipient could be greater than this?"

17.18.s:
savyaṃ kṛtvā balirdarbhānsākṣatāndakṣiṇe kare ..
prayogaṃ na guruścakre na muṃcati jalaṃ kare .. 242 ..
17.18.d:
सव्यं कृत्वा बलिर्दर्भान्साक्षतान्दक्षिणे करे ..
प्रयोगं न गुरुश्चक्रे न मुंचति जलं करे .. 242 ..
17.18.m: Bali placed darbha grass with unbroken rice grains into his right hand; / the teacher did not perform the ritual, nor did he release water into the hand.

17.18.s:
vismitā ṛṣayaḥ sarve hotāro ye sabhāsadaḥ ..
brāhmaṇā baṭavo daityā bhāryāputrāśca bāṃdhavāḥ .. 243 ..
17.18.d:
विस्मिता ऋषयः सर्वे होतारो ये सभासदः ..
ब्राह्मणा बटवो दैत्या भार्यापुत्राश्च बांधवाः .. 243 ..
17.18.m: All the seers, the Hotṛ priests who were members of the assembly, / the brahmins, students, Daityas, and wives, sons, and kinsmen were astonished:

17.18.s:
dattaṃ gṛhītamityukte kasmāttoyaṃ na muñcati ..
vāmanāya kare toyaṃ vivekāya pradīyate .. 244 ..
17.18.d:
दत्तं गृहीतमित्युक्ते कस्मात्तोयं न मुञ्चति ..
वामनाय करे तोयं विवेकाय प्रदीयते .. 244 ..
17.18.m: "When 'Given' and 'Accepted' have been uttered, why does he not release the water? / Water is given into the hand of the dwarf for the sake of discernment.

17.18.s:
yaddānaṃ vacasā dattaṃ karmaṇā nopapādyate ..
vidhāya narake pūye yajamānaṃ na niṣkṛtiḥ .. 245 ..
17.18.d:
यद्दानं वचसा दत्तं कर्मणा नोपपाद्यते ..
विधाय नरके पूये यजमानं न निष्कृतिः .. 245 ..
17.18.m: A gift that is promised by speech but not carried out by deed / casts the patron of the sacrifice into a hell of pus, without expiation."

17.18.s:
uśanā prāha daityendra vāmano harirityayam ..
kenāpi daivayogena tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ samupāgataḥ .. 246 ..
17.18.d:
उशना प्राह दैत्येन्द्र वामनो हरिरित्ययम् ..
केनापि दैवयोगेन त्वां द्रष्टुं समुपागतः .. 246 ..
17.18.m: Uśanas said: "O king of Daityas, this dwarf is Hari; / by some decree of destiny he has arrived to see you.

17.18.s:
apriyaṃ vā priyaṃ vāpi na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati ..
babhāṣe bhārgavaṃ yaṣṭā śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ guro .. 247 ..
17.18.d:
अप्रियं वा प्रियं वापि न जाने किं करिष्यति ..
बभाषे भार्गवं यष्टा श्रूयतां वचनं गुरो .. 247 ..
17.18.m: Pleasant or unpleasant, I do not know what he will do." / The sacrificer spoke to Bhārgava: "O teacher, hear my words!

17.18.s:
procyate dānakāleṣu yajamānairdvijairapi ..
ahamindro dvijo viṣṇurdravyamādityadevatā ..
tatkathaṃ na mayā deyaṃ viṣṇave prīyatāmiti .. 248 ..
17.18.d:
प्रोच्यते दानकालेषु यजमानैर्द्विजैरपि ..
अहमिन्द्रो द्विजो विष्णुर्द्रव्यमादित्यदेवता ..
तत्कथं न मया देयं विष्णवे प्रीयतामिति .. 248 ..
17.18.m: At times of giving, this is uttered by sacrificers and by brahmins: / 'I am Indra, the brahmin is Viṣṇu, the substance is the deity Āditya.' / Therefore, how can I not give, saying, 'May Viṣṇu be pleased'?"

17.18.s:
ityuktvā sa dadau toyaṃ vāmanāya kare baliḥ ..
tataḥ kimidamityuktvā saṃsthito maṇḍapādbahiḥ ..249..
17.18.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स ददौ तोयं वामनाय करे बलिः ..
ततः किमिदमित्युक्त्वा संस्थितो मण्डपाद्बहिः ..249..
17.18.m: Having spoken thus, Bali poured the water into the dwarf's hand; / then, having said, "What is this?" he stood outside the pavilion.

17.18.s:
madhye'pi vāmano vipro balimātro vabhūva saḥ ..
dattahasto'surendreṇa grahītuṃ tu padatrayam ..7.2.18.250 ..
17.18.d:
मध्येऽपि वामनो विप्रो बलिमात्रो वभूव सः ..
दत्तहस्तोऽसुरेन्द्रेण ग्रहीतुं तु पदत्रयम् ..7.2.18.250 ..
17.18.m: Even in the middle [of the hall], the dwarf brahmin became the height of Bali, / with the hand offered by the lord of Asuras in order to take the three paces.

17.18.s:
yajamānadvijau haṣṭau dṛṣṭau yajñe surādibhiḥ ..
vavṛdhe vāmanotīva kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam ..251..
17.18.d:
यजमानद्विजौ हष्टौ दृष्टौ यज्ञे सुरादिभिः ..
ववृधे वामनोतीव कृत्वा रूपं चतुर्भुजम् ..251..
17.18.m: The sacrificer and the brahmin were seen to be joyful at the sacrifice by the gods and others; / assuming a four-armed form, the dwarf grew exceedingly.

17.18.s:
nārado'pi samāyāto babhāṣe ki kṛtaṃ bale ..
śiṣyābhyāṃ sahito hṛṣṭo narīnarti puraḥ sthitaḥ .. 252 ..
17.18.d:
नारदोऽपि समायातो बभाषे कि कृतं बले ..
शिष्याभ्यां सहितो हृष्टो नरीनर्ति पुरः स्थितः .. 252 ..
17.18.m: Nārada too arrived and said: “O Bali, what have you done?” / Accompanied by his two disciples, delighted, he danced again and again, standing before him.

17.18.s:
gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇāṃ deva sabhāryo bhāṣate baliḥ ..
adya kiṃ na mayā prāptaṃ yadgṛhṇāti janārddanaḥ .. .. 253 ..
17.18.d:
गृहाण दक्षिणां देव सभार्यो भाषते बलिः ..
अद्य किं न मया प्राप्तं यद्गृह्णाति जनार्द्दनः .. .. 253 ..
17.18.m: “Accept the priestly fee, O Lord!” Bali spoke together with his wife: / “What have I not attained today, seeing that Janārdana accepts [it]?

17.18.s:
sārddhakramakṣayaṃ kṛtvā dharaṇīṃ yācate trayam ..
yadasti tena kartavyaḥ santoṣo madhusūdana .. 254 ..
17.18.d:
सार्द्धक्रमक्षयं कृत्वा धरणीं याचते त्रयम् ..
यदस्ति तेन कर्तव्यः सन्तोषो मधुसूदन .. 254 ..
17.18.m: Having measured out a step and a half, he asks for three [steps] of earth. / With whatever there is, satisfaction should be made, O Madhusūdana!”

17.18.s:
varddhamānaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇā ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ ..
tuṣṭuvurgagane yāṃtaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ janārddanam .. 255 ..
17.18.d:
वर्द्धमानं हरिं दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणा ऋषयः सुराः ..
तुष्टुवुर्गगने यांतं भगवंतं जनार्द्दनम् .. 255 ..
17.18.m: Seeing Hari growing, the brahmins, seers, and gods / praised the Lord Janārdana as he went through the sky.

17.18.s:
.. devarṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
jaya deva jayānanta jaya viṣṇo jayā'cyuta ..
jaya matsya namastubhyaṃ jaya kūrma dharādhara .. 256 ..
17.18.d:
.. देवर्षय ऊचुः .. ..
जय देव जयानन्त जय विष्णो जयाऽच्युत ..
जय मत्स्य नमस्तुभ्यं जय कूर्म धराधर .. 256 ..
17.18.m: The celestial seers said: / “Victory, O God! Victory, O Infinite One! Victory, O Viṣṇu! Victory, O Acyuta! / Victory, O Fish, homage to you! Victory, O Tortoise, bearer of the earth!

17.18.s:
varāhāya namastubhyaṃ narasiṃha namonamaḥ ..
jāmadagnya namastubhyaṃ jaya rāma salakṣmaṇa .. 257 ..
17.18.d:
वराहाय नमस्तुभ्यं नरसिंह नमोनमः ..
जामदग्न्य नमस्तुभ्यं जय राम सलक्ष्मण .. 257 ..
17.18.m: Homage to you, the Boar! Homage, homage, O Narasiṃha! / Homage to you, son of Jamadagni! Victory, O Rāma with Lakṣmaṇa!

17.18.s:
jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya devakinandana ..
namāmi buddhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca kalkinaṃ praṇamāmyaham ..258..
17.18.d:
जय कृष्ण जगन्नाथ जय देवकिनन्दन ..
नमामि बुद्धं कृष्णं च कल्किनं प्रणमाम्यहम् ..258..
17.18.m: Victory, O Kṛṣṇa, Lord of the Universe! Victory, O son of Devakī! / I bow to Buddha and Kṛṣṇa, and I prostrate before Kalkin!”

17.18.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
narīnarti tathā stauti nārado gaganaṃ gataḥ ..
yoginaḥ sanakādyā ye stuvaṃti ca janārdanam .. 259 ..
17.18.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
नरीनर्ति तथा स्तौति नारदो गगनं गतः ..
योगिनः सनकाद्या ये स्तुवंति च जनार्दनम् .. 259 ..
17.18.m: Sārasvata said: / Gone to the sky, Nārada dances again and again and praises thus. / The yogins, Sanaka and the others, also praise Janārdana.

17.18.s:
antarikṣe gate kṛṣṇe varddhamāne baleḥ puraḥ ..
ūrdhvavaktrāḥ sthitāḥ sarve nirī kṣante divākaram .. 7.2.18.260 ..
17.18.d:
अन्तरिक्षे गते कृष्णे वर्द्धमाने बलेः पुरः ..
ऊर्ध्ववक्त्राः स्थिताः सर्वे निरी क्षन्ते दिवाकरम् .. 7.2.18.260 ..
17.18.m: When Kṛṣṇa had gone into the intermediate space, growing before Bali, / all stood with faces upturned, gazing at the sun.

17.18.s:
dṛṣṭacchatrākṛtistāvatpaścādūrdhvaṃ gato hariḥ ..
cūḍāmaṇirivābhāti bhāskaro harimastake .. 261 ..
17.18.d:
दृष्टच्छत्राकृतिस्तावत्पश्चादूर्ध्वं गतो हरिः ..
चूडामणिरिवाभाति भास्करो हरिमस्तके .. 261 ..
17.18.m: At first seen having the form of a parasol, Hari then went higher; / the sun shone like a crest-jewel on Hari’s head.

17.18.s:
daityairnirīkṣitaḥ samyaglalāṭe tilakāyate ..
hariḥ saṃvarddhate yāvatkarṇe'sau kuṇḍalāyate ..262..
17.18.d:
दैत्यैर्निरीक्षितः सम्यग्ललाटे तिलकायते ..
हरिः संवर्द्धते यावत्कर्णेऽसौ कुण्डलायते ..262..
17.18.m: Closely observed by the Daityas, it served as a tilaka on his forehead. / As Hari grew further, it became an earring at his ear.

17.18.s:
varddhamānasya ca harerhṛdaye kaustubhāyate ..
iṃdrādyā devatā rudrā vasavo gagane sthitāḥ .. 263 ..
17.18.d:
वर्द्धमानस्य च हरेर्हृदये कौस्तुभायते ..
इंद्राद्या देवता रुद्रा वसवो गगने स्थिताः .. 263 ..
17.18.m: And on the chest of Hari as he grew, it became the Kaustubha jewel. / The deities headed by Indra, the Rudras, and the Vasus stood in the sky.

17.18.s:
ūrdhvaṃ punaryatra harirna tatra gaganaṃ matam ..
vanamālā tadā kaṇṭhe vāsavena niveśitā .. 264 ..
17.18.d:
ऊर्ध्वं पुनर्यत्र हरिर्न तत्र गगनं मतम् ..
वनमाला तदा कण्ठे वासवेन निवेशिता .. 264 ..
17.18.m: Higher still, where Hari reached, no sky is acknowledged. / Then a garland of forest flowers was placed upon his neck by Vāsava.

17.18.s:
pṛthivī kampate sarvā divisthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam ..
kiṃ bhaviṣyati daityāste bhītāḥ paśyaṃti bhāskaram .. 265 ..
17.18.d:
पृथिवी कम्पते सर्वा दिविस्थं सूर्यमण्डलम् ..
किं भविष्यति दैत्यास्ते भीताः पश्यंति भास्करम् .. 265 ..
17.18.m: The entire earth trembled, and the orb of the sun stood in heaven. / “What will happen?” Terrified, the Daityas looked at the sun.

17.18.s:
nābhau padmāyate sūryaḥ kaṭau ca raśanāyate ..
evaṃ saṃvarddhito viṣṇurjagṛhe ca padadvayam .. 266 ..
17.18.d:
नाभौ पद्मायते सूर्यः कटौ च रशनायते ..
एवं संवर्द्धितो विष्णुर्जगृहे च पदद्वयम् .. 266 ..
17.18.m: At his navel the sun became a lotus, and at his hips it became a girdle. / Having thus grown, Viṣṇu took two steps.

17.18.s:
sthānaṃ nāsti tṛtīyasya brahmāṃḍaṃ sakalaṃ kṛtam ..
ahardaṇḍo jagatsraṣṭā brahmadaṃḍāyate tadā .. 267 ..
17.18.d:
स्थानं नास्ति तृतीयस्य ब्रह्मांडं सकलं कृतम् ..
अहर्दण्डो जगत्स्रष्टा ब्रह्मदंडायते तदा .. 267 ..
17.18.m: There was no place for the third; the entire egg of Brahmā was occupied. / The creator of the world then became the staff of Brahmā, a staff of daytime.

17.18.s:
devadānava gaṃdharvamanuṣyoragapannagaiḥ ..
pūjyate caraṇo viṣṇoḥ stūyate cānumīyate .. 268 ..
17.18.d:
देवदानव गंधर्वमनुष्योरगपन्नगैः ..
पूज्यते चरणो विष्णोः स्तूयते चानुमीयते .. 268 ..
17.18.m: By gods, Dānavas, Gandharvas, humans, snakes, and serpents, / the foot of Viṣṇu was worshipped, praised, and contemplated:

17.18.s:
dharmātmā yatadaṇḍo hi gaṃdharvairgīyate muhuḥ ..
jyotiścakrākṣadaṃḍaḥ kiṃ hariṇā nirmitaḥ svayam .. 269 ..
17.18.d:
धर्मात्मा यतदण्डो हि गंधर्वैर्गीयते मुहुः ..
ज्योतिश्चक्राक्षदंडः किं हरिणा निर्मितः स्वयम् .. 269 ..
17.18.m: “Indeed, the righteous one whose staff is restrained is sung of repeatedly by Gandharvas: / Was this axle-staff of the circle of luminaries fashioned by Hari himself?

17.18.s:
jitvedaṃ bhuvanaṃ gaṃgā dhvajadaṃḍo'maraiḥ kṛtaḥ ..
trivikramāṃghridaṇḍo'yaṃ kīrtidaṃḍāyate dhruvam.. 7.2.18.270 ..
17.18.d:
जित्वेदं भुवनं गंगा ध्वजदंडोऽमरैः कृतः ..
त्रिविक्रमांघ्रिदण्डोऽयं कीर्तिदंडायते ध्रुवम्.. 7.2.18.270 ..
17.18.m: Having conquered this world, the Gaṅgā was made into a banner-staff by the immortals. / This staff that is Trivikrama’s foot certainly acts as a staff of fame!”

17.18.s:
vegenākṣipya hariṇā nīto brahmāṃḍamastake ..
pādastanmastakaṃ bhittvā bahiryāsyati vegataḥ .. 271 ..
17.18.d:
वेगेनाक्षिप्य हरिणा नीतो ब्रह्मांडमस्तके ..
पादस्तन्मस्तकं भित्त्वा बहिर्यास्यति वेगतः .. 271 ..
17.18.m: Hurled with speed, it was brought by Hari to the top of the egg of Brahmā. / Having pierced its summit, his foot went swiftly outside.

17.18.s:
tāvadbrahmāṃḍavego'yaṃ virāḍiti hi saṃjñitaḥ ..
sa sarva bījarūpo hi paramātmeti gadyate .. 272 ..
17.18.d:
तावद्ब्रह्मांडवेगोऽयं विराडिति हि संज्ञितः ..
स सर्व बीजरूपो हि परमात्मेति गद्यते .. 272 ..
17.18.m: Now this force of the egg of Brahmā is indeed called Virāj; / he, of the nature of the seed of all, is spoken of as the Supreme Self.

17.18.s:
tenedaṃ sakalaṃ jātaṃ pādasyāgre vyavasthitam..
brahmāṃḍabhedanaṃ kṛtvā na gantavyaṃ bahistvayā .. 273 ..
17.18.d:
तेनेदं सकलं जातं पादस्याग्रे व्यवस्थितम्..
ब्रह्मांडभेदनं कृत्वा न गन्तव्यं बहिस्त्वया .. 273 ..
17.18.m: By him all this was produced; he stood before the foot: / “Having pierced the egg of Brahmā, you must not go outside!”

17.18.s:
tenaiva saha brahmāṃḍe paphāla caraṇo hareḥ ..
brahmāṃḍaṃ jarjaraṃ jātaṃ pādasaṃkocanādapi .. 274 ..
17.18.d:
तेनैव सह ब्रह्मांडे पफाल चरणो हरेः ..
ब्रह्मांडं जर्जरं जातं पादसंकोचनादपि .. 274 ..
17.18.m: With that, Hari’s foot burst within the egg of Brahmā; / the egg of Brahmā became shattered even from the contraction of his foot.

17.18.s:
bhinne tasminsamāyātaṃ brāhmaṃ toyaṃ jagattraye ..
viṣṇupādodbhavā gaṃgā mastakānniḥsṛtā tadā .. 275 ..
17.18.d:
भिन्ने तस्मिन्समायातं ब्राह्मं तोयं जगत्त्रये ..
विष्णुपादोद्भवा गंगा मस्तकान्निःसृता तदा .. 275 ..
17.18.m: When it was pierced, the water of Brahmā entered into the three worlds; / then the Gaṅgā, arisen from Viṣṇu’s foot, issued from the summit.

17.18.s:
trailokyaplāvinī devī yā rudreṇa svayaṃ dhṛtā ..
svardhunī pūjyate svarge gaṃgeti gāṃ gatā satī .. .. 276 ..
17.18.d:
त्रैलोक्यप्लाविनी देवी या रुद्रेण स्वयं धृता ..
स्वर्धुनी पूज्यते स्वर्गे गंगेति गां गता सती .. .. 276 ..
17.18.m: The goddess who inundates the three worlds, who was held by Rudra himself; / as the river of heaven, she is worshipped in heaven, and having gone to the earth, she is the Gaṅgā.

17.18.s:
pātāle sā yadā prāptā khyātā tripathagaiva sā ..
yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 277 ..
17.18.d:
पाताले सा यदा प्राप्ता ख्याता त्रिपथगैव सा ..
यस्याः स्मरणमात्रेण सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 277 ..
17.18.m: When she reached Pātāla, she became known as the Triple-Path River, / through the mere remembrance of whom there is the destruction of all sins.

17.18.s:
darśanādaśvamedhasya saṃpūrṇasya phalaṃ labhet ..
snānamātreṇa naśyeta saptajanmakṛtaṃ tvagham ..278..
17.18.d:
दर्शनादश्वमेधस्य संपूर्णस्य फलं लभेत् ..
स्नानमात्रेण नश्येत सप्तजन्मकृतं त्वघम् ..278..
17.18.m: From seeing her, one obtains the complete fruit of a horse sacrifice; / by mere bathing in her, the evil committed over seven births is destroyed.

17.18.s:
snātvā saṃpūjayedyastu devau hariharau naraḥ ..
indralokamatikramya viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. .. 279 ..
17.18.d:
स्नात्वा संपूजयेद्यस्तु देवौ हरिहरौ नरः ..
इन्द्रलोकमतिक्रम्य विष्णुलोके महीयते .. .. 279 ..
17.18.m: The man who, having bathed, worships the two gods Hari and Hara, / having passed beyond the world of Indra, is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

17.18.s:
viṣṇupādodakaṃ pītvā jñātvā tattvāni saṃyamī ..
upoṣya divasaṃ viṣṇormuktiṃ gacchati dehavān.. 7.2.18.280 ..
17.18.d:
विष्णुपादोदकं पीत्वा ज्ञात्वा तत्त्वानि संयमी ..
उपोष्य दिवसं विष्णोर्मुक्तिं गच्छति देहवान्.. 7.2.18.280 ..
17.18.m: Having drunk the water from Viṣṇu’s foot, having known the realities, self-controlled, / having fasted on the day of Viṣṇu, an embodied soul attains liberation.

17.18.s:
śuddhasvabhāvasattvasthā viraktā janmabhūmiṣu ..
saṃsārabaṃdhanaṃ chittvā yāti te paramāṃ gatim .. 281 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye balinigrahavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 18 ..
17.18.d:
शुद्धस्वभावसत्त्वस्था विरक्ता जन्मभूमिषु ..
संसारबंधनं छित्त्वा याति ते परमां गतिम् .. 281 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे द्वितीये वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बलिनिग्रहवृत्तांतवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोऽध्यायः .. 18 ..
17.18.m:
Abiding in goodness of pure nature, detached from birthplaces, / having cut the bond of saṃsāra, they go to the supreme state.
Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Subjugation of Bali’, in the Māhātmya of the Vastrāpatha Sacred Field, in the second [sub-section of] Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

17.19.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
gṛhītvā dakṣiṇāṃ daityānmahāviṣṇurjanārdanaḥ ...
cakāra kiṃ mamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 1 ..
17.19.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
गृहीत्वा दक्षिणां दैत्यान्महाविष्णुर्जनार्दनः ...
चकार किं ममाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 1 ..
17.19.m: The king said: / “Having taken the priestly fee from the Daitya, what did the Great Viṣṇu, Janārdana, / do? Tell me, for my curiosity is great.”

17.19.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
evaṃ stutaḥ surairdevo gṛhītvā medinīṃ hariḥ ..
baliṃ nirvāsayāmāsa saṃpūrṇe yajñakarmaṇi ..
yajñāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ labdhvā saṃpūrṇo'bhūdathādhvaraḥ .. 2 ..
17.19.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
एवं स्तुतः सुरैर्देवो गृहीत्वा मेदिनीं हरिः ..
बलिं निर्वासयामास संपूर्णे यज्ञकर्मणि ..
यज्ञांते दक्षिणां लब्ध्वा संपूर्णोऽभूदथाध्वरः .. 2 ..
17.19.m: Sārasvata said: / “Thus praised by the gods, having taken the earth, the divine Hari / banished Bali once the ritual of the sacrifice was completed; / having received the priestly fee at the end of the sacrifice, the sacrifice was then complete.

17.19.s:
bhagavānapyasaṃpūrṇe tṛtīye tu krame vibhuḥ ..
samabhyetya baliṃ prāha īṣatprasphuritādharaḥ .. 3 ..
17.19.d:
भगवानप्यसंपूर्णे तृतीये तु क्रमे विभुः ..
समभ्येत्य बलिं प्राह ईषत्प्रस्फुरिताधरः .. 3 ..
17.19.m: When the third step remained incomplete, the all-pervading Lord, / having approached Bali with lips slightly quivering, said:

17.19.s:
ṛṇe bhavati daityendra baṃdhanaṃ ghoradarśanam ..
tvaṃ pūraya padaṃ tanme nocedbandhaṃ pratīccha bhoḥ .. 4 ..
17.19.d:
ऋणे भवति दैत्येन्द्र बंधनं घोरदर्शनम् ..
त्वं पूरय पदं तन्मे नोचेद्बन्धं प्रतीच्छ भोः .. 4 ..
17.19.m: ‘For debt, O lord of Daityas, there is dreadful bondage. / Fill that step for me, or else submit to bondage, O king!’

17.19.s:
tanmurārivacaḥ śrutvā puro bhūtvā baleḥ sutaḥ ..
bāṇo vāmanamācaṣṭe tadā taṃ viśvarūpiṇam .. 5 ..
17.19.d:
तन्मुरारिवचः श्रुत्वा पुरो भूत्वा बलेः सुतः ..
बाणो वामनमाचष्टे तदा तं विश्वरूपिणम् .. 5 ..
17.19.m: Hearing that word of Murāri, Bali’s son Bāṇa / stepped forward and said to the dwarf who had assumed the universal form:

17.19.s:
kṛtvā mahīmalpatarāṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā tu vāmanam..
padatrayaṃ yācayitvā viśvarūpamagāḥ katham .. 6 ..
17.19.d:
कृत्वा महीमल्पतरां वपुः कृत्वा तु वामनम्..
पदत्रयं याचयित्वा विश्वरूपमगाः कथम् .. 6 ..
17.19.m: ‘Having made the earth so very small and having made your body a dwarf, / and having begged for three steps, how did you attain the universal form?

17.19.s:
yadi tṛtīyaṃ kramaṇaṃ yācase jagadīśvara ..
punarvāmanatāṃ yāhi balirdāsyati tatpadam.. 7 ..
17.19.d:
यदि तृतीयं क्रमणं याचसे जगदीश्वर ..
पुनर्वामनतां याहि बलिर्दास्यति तत्पदम्.. 7 ..
17.19.m: If you ask for the third stride, O Lord of the Universe, / return to being a dwarf; Bali will grant that step!

17.19.s:
yādṛgvidhāya balinā vāmanāyodakaṃ kṛtam..
tattādṛśāya dātavyamatha kiṃ viśvarūpiṇe .. 8 ..
17.19.d:
यादृग्विधाय बलिना वामनायोदकं कृतम्..
तत्तादृशाय दातव्यमथ किं विश्वरूपिणे .. 8 ..
17.19.m: Water was poured by Bali for someone of such a size as the dwarf; / [the gift] should be given to one of such a size—why now to one of universal form?

17.19.s:
bhavatkṛtamidaṃ viśvaṃ viśvasminvartate baliḥ ..
chadmanā naiva gṛhṇanti sādhavo ye maheśvara .. 9 ..
17.19.d:
भवत्कृतमिदं विश्वं विश्वस्मिन्वर्तते बलिः ..
छद्मना नैव गृह्णन्ति साधवो ये महेश्वर .. 9 ..
17.19.m: This universe was made by you, and Bali exists within the universe. / Those who are virtuous do not take by deceit, O Maheśvara!

17.19.s:
jagadetajjagannātha tāvakaṃ yadi manyase ..
jñātvā balimamaryādaṃ bhavadbhaktiparāṅmukham .. 7.2.19.10 ..
17.19.d:
जगदेतज्जगन्नाथ तावकं यदि मन्यसे ..
ज्ञात्वा बलिममर्यादं भवद्भक्तिपराङ्मुखम् .. 7.2.19.10 ..
17.19.m: If you consider this universe your own, O Lord of the Universe, / knowing Bali to be beyond limits and averse to devotion to you—’

17.19.s:
kaṃṭhapāśena niṣkāsya kena vai vāryate bhavān..
gopālamanyaṃ kurute rakṣaṇāya ca gopatiḥ ..
sutṛṇaṃ cārayanpūrvo gopaḥ kiṃ kurute tadā .. 11 ..
17.19.d:
कंठपाशेन निष्कास्य केन वै वार्यते भवान्..
गोपालमन्यं कुरुते रक्षणाय च गोपतिः ..
सुतृणं चारयन्पूर्वो गोपः किं कुरुते तदा .. 11 ..

17.19.s:
ityevamukte tenātha vacane balisūnunā ..
provāca bhagavānvākyamādikartā janārdanaḥ ..12..
17.19.d:
इत्येवमुक्ते तेनाथ वचने बलिसूनुना ..
प्रोवाच भगवान्वाक्यमादिकर्ता जनार्दनः ..12..
17.19.m:
When these words were thus spoken by that son of Bali,
the blessed Lord Janārdana, the primal creator, spoke these words:

17.19.s:
yānyuktāni vacāṃsītthaṃ tvayā bālena sāṃpratam..
teṣāṃ tvaṃ hetusaṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu pratyuttaraṃ mama .. 13 ..
17.19.d:
यान्युक्तानि वचांसीत्थं त्वया बालेन सांप्रतम्..
तेषां त्वं हेतुसंयुक्तं शृणु प्रत्युत्तरं मम .. 13 ..
17.19.m:
“The words that have been spoken in this manner by you, a boy, just now—
hear my reasoned answer to them.

17.19.s:
pūrvamuktastava pitā mayā bāṇa padatrayam ..
dehi mahyaṃ pramāṇena tadetatsamanuṣṭhitam .. 14 ..
17.19.d:
पूर्वमुक्तस्तव पिता मया बाण पदत्रयम् ..
देहि मह्यं प्रमाणेन तदेतत्समनुष्ठितम् .. 14 ..
17.19.m:
Formerly your father was told by me, ‘O Bāṇa, three paces
give to me by [my own] measure.’ That very thing was agreed upon.

17.19.s:
kiṃ na vetti pramāṇaṃ me balistava pitā suta ..
balerapi hitārthāya kṛtametatpadatrayam .. 15 ..
17.19.d:
किं न वेत्ति प्रमाणं मे बलिस्तव पिता सुत ..
बलेरपि हितार्थाय कृतमेतत्पदत्रयम् .. 15 ..
17.19.m:
Does your father Bali not know my measure, my son?
Even for Bali’s benefit were these three paces taken.

17.19.s:
tasmādyanmama bāleya tvatpitrāṃ'bu kare mahat ..
dattaṃ tenāsya sutale kalpaṃ yāvadvasiṣyati .. 16 ..
17.19.d:
तस्माद्यन्मम बालेय त्वत्पित्रांऽबु करे महत् ..
दत्तं तेनास्य सुतले कल्पं यावद्वसिष्यति .. 16 ..
17.19.m:
Therefore, O son of Bali, because water was poured into my hand by your father,
by that he shall reside in Sutala for the duration of a kalpa.

17.19.s:
gate manvantare bāṇa śrāddhadevasya sāmpratam ..
sāvarṇike tvāgate ca balirindro bhaviṣyati .. 17 ..
17.19.d:
गते मन्वन्तरे बाण श्राद्धदेवस्य साम्प्रतम् ..
सावर्णिके त्वागते च बलिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति .. 17 ..
17.19.m:
When the present manvantara of Śrāddhadeva has passed, O Bāṇa,
and the Sāvarṇika [manvantara] has arrived, Bali will become Indra.”

17.19.s:
iti proktvā balisutaṃ bāṇaṃ devastrivikramaḥ ..
provāca balimabhyetya vacanaṃ madhurākṣaram .. 18 ..
17.19.d:
इति प्रोक्त्वा बलिसुतं बाणं देवस्त्रिविक्रमः ..
प्रोवाच बलिमभ्येत्य वचनं मधुराक्षरम् .. 18 ..
17.19.m:
Having spoken thus to Bali's son Bāṇa, the god Trivikrama,
approaching Bali, spoke sweet words:

17.19.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
apūrṇadakṣiṇe yāge gaccha rājanmahātalam ..
sutalaṃnāma pātālaṃ vasa tatra nirāmayaḥ .. 19 ..
17.19.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अपूर्णदक्षिणे यागे गच्छ राजन्महातलम् ..
सुतलंनाम पातालं वस तत्र निरामयः .. 19 ..
17.19.m:
The Blessed Lord said:
“The sacrifice being incomplete in its sacrificial fees, go, O king, to Mahātala,
the netherworld named Sutala; dwell there free from affliction.

17.19.s:
.. baliruvāca .. ..
sutalasthasya me nātha kathaṃ caraṇayostava ..
darśanaṃ pūjanaṃ bhogo nivasāmi yathāsukham .. 7.2.19.20
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
daityendra hadaye nityaṃ tāvake nivasāmyaham ..
ataste darśanaṃ prāptaḥ punaḥ sthāsye tavāntikam .. 21 ..
17.19.d:
.. बलिरुवाच .. ..
सुतलस्थस्य मे नाथ कथं चरणयोस्तव ..
दर्शनं पूजनं भोगो निवसामि यथासुखम् .. 7.2.19.20
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
दैत्येन्द्र हदये नित्यं तावके निवसाम्यहम् ..
अतस्ते दर्शनं प्राप्तः पुनः स्थास्ये तवान्तिकम् .. 21 ..
17.19.m:
Bali said:
“As I dwell in Sutala, O Lord, how shall I have
darśana of your feet, worship, and enjoyment, so that I live happily?”
The Blessed Lord said:
“O lord of the Daityas, I dwell eternally in your heart;
therefore you have attained my darśana, and again I will remain beside you.

17.19.s:
tathānyamutsavaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛtte śakramahotsave ..
dīpapratipannāmā'sau tatra bhāvī mahotsavaḥ .. 22 ..
17.19.d:
तथान्यमुत्सवं पुण्यं वृत्ते शक्रमहोत्सवे ..
दीपप्रतिपन्नामाऽसौ तत्र भावी महोत्सवः .. 22 ..
17.19.m:
Likewise, another holy festival, once the great festival of Indra has passed—
that great festival named Dīpapratipad will take place there.

17.19.s:
tatra tvāṃ naraśārdūlā hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ ..
puṣpadīpapradānena arcayiṣyaṃti yatnataḥ .. .. 23 ..
17.19.d:
तत्र त्वां नरशार्दूला हृष्टाः पुष्टाः स्वलंकृताः ..
पुष्पदीपप्रदानेन अर्चयिष्यंति यत्नतः .. .. 23 ..
17.19.m:
There, the best among men, joyful, flourishing, and well-adorned,
will worship you diligently by offering flowers and lamps.

17.19.s:
tatrotsavaḥ puṇyatamo bhaviṣyati dharātale ..
tava nāmāṃkito daitya tena tvaṃ vatsaraṃ sukhī .. 24 ..
17.19.d:
तत्रोत्सवः पुण्यतमो भविष्यति धरातले ..
तव नामांकितो दैत्य तेन त्वं वत्सरं सुखी .. 24 ..
17.19.m:
There a most holy festival will take place on the surface of the earth,
marked with your name, O Daitya; through it you will be happy throughout the year.

17.19.s:
bhaviṣyasi narā ye tu dṛḍhabhaktisahā nvitāḥ ..
tvāmarcayanti vidhivatte'pi syuḥ sukhabhāginaḥ .. 25 ..
17.19.d:
भविष्यसि नरा ये तु दृढभक्तिसहा न्विताः ..
त्वामर्चयन्ति विधिवत्तेऽपि स्युः सुखभागिनः .. 25 ..
17.19.m:
You will be [happy], and those men endowed with firm devotion
who worship you according to the rules, they too will share in happiness.

17.19.s:
yathaiva rājyaṃ bhavatastu sāṃprataṃ tathaiva sā bhāvyatha kaumudīti ..
ityevamuktvā madhumaditīśvaraṃ nivāsayitvā sutalaṃ sabhāryakam .. 26 ..
17.19.d:
यथैव राज्यं भवतस्तु सांप्रतं तथैव सा भाव्यथ कौमुदीति ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा मधुमदितीश्वरं निवासयित्वा सुतलं सभार्यकम् .. 26 ..
17.19.m:
Just as the kingdom belongs to you now, so too shall that Kaumudī night be.”
Having spoken thus, the slayer of Madhu, having settled the lord of Daityas along with his wife in Sutala,

17.19.s:
urvī samādāya jagāma tūrṇaṃ sa śakrasadmāmarasaṃghajuṣṭam ..
dattvā maghone madhujittriviṣṭapaṃ kṛtvā tu devānmakhabhāgabhoginaḥ .. 27 ..
17.19.d:
उर्वी समादाय जगाम तूर्णं स शक्रसद्मामरसंघजुष्टम् ..
दत्त्वा मघोने मधुजित्त्रिविष्टपं कृत्वा तु देवान्मखभागभोगिनः .. 27 ..
17.19.m:
and having taken back the earth, went swiftly to the abode of Śakra, visited by hosts of immortals.
Having given the three worlds to Maghavat, and making the gods enjoy their sacrificial shares,

17.19.s: antardadhe viśvapatirmaheśaḥ saṃpaśyatāṃ vai vasudhādhipānām .. 28 ..
17.19.d: अन्तर्दधे विश्वपतिर्महेशः संपश्यतां वै वसुधाधिपानाम् .. 28 ..
17.19.m: the great lord, master of the universe, vanished while the rulers of the earth looked on.

17.19.s:
gṛhītveti bale rājyaṃ manuputre niyojitam ..
dvīpāṃtare ca te daityāḥ preṣitāścājñayā svayam ..29..
17.19.d:
गृहीत्वेति बले राज्यं मनुपुत्रे नियोजितम् ..
द्वीपांतरे च ते दैत्याः प्रेषिताश्चाज्ञया स्वयम् ..29..
17.19.m:
Having thus taken the kingdom from Bali, it was conferred upon the son of Manu,
and those Daityas were personally sent to another continent by his command.

17.19.s:
pātālanilayā ye tu te tatraiva niveśitāḥ ..
devānāṃ paramo harṣaḥ saṃjāto balinigrahe ..7.2.19.30..
17.19.d:
पातालनिलया ये तु ते तत्रैव निवेशिताः ..
देवानां परमो हर्षः संजातो बलिनिग्रहे ..7.2.19.30..
17.19.m:
Those whose abode was Pātāla were settled right there.
Supreme joy arose among the gods at the subjugation of Bali.

17.19.s:
nivāsāya punaścakre vāmano vāmano manaḥ ..
tatra kṣetre svanagare vāmanaḥ sa nyuvāsa ha .. 31 ..
17.19.d:
निवासाय पुनश्चक्रे वामनो वामनो मनः ..
तत्र क्षेत्रे स्वनगरे वामनः स न्युवास ह .. 31 ..
17.19.m:
Again Vāmana set his mind on residing [there];
in that kṣetra, in his own city, Vāmana resided.

17.19.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
prādurbhāvaste kathito narendra puṇyaḥ śucirvāmanasyāghahārī ..
smṛte yasminsaṃśrute kīrtite ca pāpaṃ yāyātsaṃkṣayaṃ puṇyameti .. 32 ..
17.19.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
प्रादुर्भावस्ते कथितो नरेन्द्र पुण्यः शुचिर्वामनस्याघहारी ..
स्मृते यस्मिन्संश्रुते कीर्तिते च पापं यायात्संक्षयं पुण्यमेति .. 32 ..

17.19.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
iti sārasvatavacaḥ śrutvā bhojaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ ..
namaskṛtya muniśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .. 33 ..
17.19.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इति सारस्वतवचः श्रुत्वा भोजः स भूपतिः ..
नमस्कृत्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं पूजयामास भक्तितः .. 33 ..
17.19.m:
Īśvara said:
Having thus heard the words of Sārasvata, King Bhoja,
bowing to that best of sages, worshipped him with devotion.

17.19.s:
tato yathoktavidhinā sa bhojo nṛpasattamaḥ ..
vastrāpathakṣetra yātrāṃ parivārajanaiḥ saha ..
kṛtvā kṛtārthatāṃ prāpto jagāmānte paraṃ padam .. 34 ..
17.19.d:
ततो यथोक्तविधिना स भोजो नृपसत्तमः ..
वस्त्रापथक्षेत्र यात्रां परिवारजनैः सह ..
कृत्वा कृतार्थतां प्राप्तो जगामान्ते परं पदम् .. 34 ..
17.19.m:
Then, according to the prescribed rules, that best of kings, Bhoja,
having performed the pilgrimage to the Vastrāpatha kṣetra along with his retinue,
attained fulfillment and went in the end to the supreme abode.

17.19.s:
etanmayā puṇyatamaṃ prabhāsakṣetre ca vasrāpathamīritaṃ te ..
śrutvā paṭhitvā parayā sameto bhaktyā tu viṣṇoḥ padamabhyupaiti .. 35 ..
17.19.d:
एतन्मया पुण्यतमं प्रभासक्षेत्रे च वस्रापथमीरितं ते ..
श्रुत्वा पठित्वा परया समेतो भक्त्या तु विष्णोः पदमभ्युपैति .. 35 ..
17.19.m:
This most holy [narrative] concerning Vastrāpatha in the Prabhāsa kṣetra has been related to you by me;
having heard or recited it, endowed with supreme devotion, one goes to the abode of Viṣṇu.

17.19.s:
yathā pāpāni dhūyaṃte gaṃgāvārivigāhanāt ..
tathā purāṇaśravaṇādduritānāṃ vinā śanam .. 36 ..
17.19.d:
यथा पापानि धूयंते गंगावारिविगाहनात् ..
तथा पुराणश्रवणाद्दुरितानां विना शनम् .. 36 ..
17.19.m:
Just as sins are washed away by bathing in the waters of the Gaṅgā,
so through the hearing of the Purāṇa comes the destruction of misdeeds.

17.19.s:
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tavoktaṃ na vācyametaddharibhaktivarjite ..
dvijasya nindānirate'tipāpe gurāvabhakte kṛtapāpabuddhau .. 37 ..
17.19.d:
इदं रहस्यं परमं तवोक्तं न वाच्यमेतद्धरिभक्तिवर्जिते ..
द्विजस्य निन्दानिरतेऽतिपापे गुरावभक्ते कृतपापबुद्धौ .. 37 ..
17.19.m:
This supreme secret has been spoken to you; it must not be told to one devoid of devotion to Hari,
to one devoted to reviling twice-borns, to a grave sinner, to one lacking devotion to the guru, or to one whose mind is set on sin.

17.19.s:
idaṃ paṭhedyo niyataṃ manuṣyaḥ kṛtabhāvanaḥ ..
tasya bhaktiḥ śive kṛṣṇe niścalā jāyate dhuvam .. 38 ..
17.19.d:
इदं पठेद्यो नियतं मनुष्यः कृतभावनः ..
तस्य भक्तिः शिवे कृष्णे निश्चला जायते धुवम् .. 38 ..
17.19.m:
Whatever man, disciplined and purified in mind, recites this,
his devotion to Śiva and Kṛṣṇa surely becomes unwavering.

17.19.s:
tadbhaktyā sakalānarthānprāpnoti puruṣottamaḥ ...
purāṇavācine dadyādgobhūsvarṇavibhūṣaṇam ..39..
17.19.d:
तद्भक्त्या सकलानर्थान्प्राप्नोति पुरुषोत्तमः ...
पुराणवाचिने दद्याद्गोभूस्वर्णविभूषणम् ..39..
17.19.m:
Through devotion to him, the best of men attains all desires.
He should give cows, land, gold, and ornaments to the reciter of the Purāṇa.

17.19.s:
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ kurvandāridryamāpnuyāt ..
triḥkṛtvā prapaṭhañchṛṇvaṃnsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..7.2.19.40..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye balaye vāmanakṛtavarapradānavṛttāntavarṇana pūrvakaṃ vastrāpathakṣetrayātrāmāhātmya sārasvatabhojasaṃvādasamāptipuraḥsara vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmyasamāptivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 19 .. ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīyaṃ vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmyaṃ sampūrṇam .. ( 7 - 2) ..
17.19.d:
वित्तशाठ्यं न कर्तव्यं कुर्वन्दारिद्र्यमाप्नुयात् ..
त्रिःकृत्वा प्रपठञ्छृण्वंन्सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ..7.2.19.40..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे द्वितीये वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बलये वामनकृतवरप्रदानवृत्तान्तवर्णन पूर्वकं वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रयात्रामाहात्म्य सारस्वतभोजसंवादसमाप्तिपुरःसर वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यसमाप्तिवर्णनं नामैकोनविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 19 .. ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराणे सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे द्वितीयं वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं सम्पूर्णम् .. ( 7 - 2) ..
17.19.m:
One must not practice deceit in money; by doing so, one would incur poverty.
Reciting or listening three times, one attains all desires.
Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, entitled ‘The Account of the Bestowal of Boons on Bali by Vāmana, preceded by the Māhātmya of the Pilgrimage to Vastrāpathakṣetra, Concluding the Dialogue between Sārasvata and Bhoja, and Concluding the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya,’ in the second [sub-section], the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Thus ends the second [part], the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. (7.2)

17.20.m: Previous page (Chapters 16–19)

17.20.s: atha prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīyaṃ vastrāpatha ( giranāra) kṣetramāhātmyam .. (7-2) ..
17.20.d: अथ प्रभासखण्डे द्वितीयं वस्त्रापथ ( गिरनार) क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यम् .. (7-2) ..
17.20.m: Now begins the second [part], the Vastrāpatha (Girnār) kṣetramāhātmya, in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa. (7.2)
