17.20.d: 1 दामोदरमाहात्म्यवर्णने कस्यचिद्गजसंज्ञकस्य राज्ञो गृहे बहूनामृषीणामागमनम्, तत्र गजेन पृष्टैरृषिभिर्गजराजाय सर्वतीर्थक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यकथनम्, नाममाहात्म्य-वर्णनम्, दामोदरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् - 200 1
17.20.m: 1. In the account of the māhātmya of Dāmodara: the arrival of many seers at the house of a certain king named Gaja; there, when questioned by Gaja, the seers relate to King Gaja the māhātmya of all tīrthas and kṣetras; account of the māhātmya of the Name; account of the māhātmya of Dāmodara — 200 1
2. Demonstration of the etymological meaning of the word Bhava; account of the establishment of Bhava by the gods; account of the māhātmya of Bhava — 202 2

3. Account of the māhātmya of the Svarṇarekhā river; proclamation of the foremost tīrthas situated in the Vastrāpathakṣetra, such as Brahmakumbha, Brahmeśvara, Kālamegha, Dāmodara, Kālikā, Bhavendreśvara, Raivata, Ujjayanta, Kumbhīśvara, and Bhīmeśvara — 202 2
4. Account of the māhātmya of Dunnāvalli-hṛd-giri-sthāna — 203 1
5 Description of the māhātmya of Gaṅgeśvara. [p.] 203.1

17.20.s: 6 cakratīrthayātrāvidhivarṇanam, mṛgavatplavanakāribālādarśanaṃ kṛtamiti kenacidvanapālena bhojarājāya kathanam, tacchrutvā tuṣṭena bhojena tasmai vanapālāya bahudhanadānam, tatastena vanapālena saha tatra vane gatvā bhojena tāṃ mṛgavaktrāṃ bālāṃ gṛhītvā svagṛhe gamanam, tato bhojena tasyai bālāyai mānuṣyaśarīratvamṛgavaktratvaśāpakakāraṇe pṛṣṭe tayā'kathane bhojena viprebhyaḥ praśnakaraṇam, tataḥ sārasvatamaharṣisaṃskatapuroḍāśa-prāśanasamupalabdha spaṣṭavākprasaramṛgānanā kathitobhayaprāksaptajanmavṛttāntavarṇanama, 203 1 7 mṛgānanābhojarājasaṃvāde svotpattivarṇanaprasaṃga uddālakarṣermūtrasarjanāya vanāntare gamanam, tatra tasya vīryabindupatanam, tatraikayā mṛgyoddālakavīryabiṃduprāśanam, tata uddālakānmṛgyāṃ mṛgānanāyāḥ svasyā janmeti bhojāya mṛgānanayā kathanam, dvāra-vatīkurukṣetrādibahutīrthakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanam, svarṇarekhāyāṃ mṛgānanāyāḥ pūrvajanma-mṛgamukhaprakṣepaṇena divyamukhatvaprāptyuttaraṃ bhojanṛpatipariṇayavṛttāntapūrvakaṃ svarṇa-rekhāmāhātmyavarṇanam ... .. ... ... ... ... 206 1
17.20.d: 6 चक्रतीर्थयात्राविधिवर्णनम्, मृगवत्प्लवनकारिबालादर्शनं कृतमिति केनचिद्वनपालेन भोजराजाय कथनम्, तच्छ्रुत्वा तुष्टेन भोजेन तस्मै वनपालाय बहुधनदानम्, ततस्तेन वनपालेन सह तत्र वने गत्वा भोजेन तां मृगवक्त्रां बालां गृहीत्वा स्वगृहे गमनम्, ततो भोजेन तस्यै बालायै मानुष्यशरीरत्वमृगवक्त्रत्वशापककारणे पृष्टे तयाऽकथने भोजेन विप्रेभ्यः प्रश्नकरणम्, ततः सारस्वतमहर्षिसंस्कतपुरोडाश-प्राशनसमुपलब्ध स्पष्टवाक्प्रसरमृगानना कथितोभयप्राक्सप्तजन्मवृत्तान्तवर्णनम, 203 1 7 मृगाननाभोजराजसंवादे स्वोत्पत्तिवर्णनप्रसंग उद्दालकर्षेर्मूत्रसर्जनाय वनान्तरे गमनम्, तत्र तस्य वीर्यबिन्दुपतनम्, तत्रैकया मृग्योद्दालकवीर्यबिंदुप्राशनम्, तत उद्दालकान्मृग्यां मृगाननायाः स्वस्या जन्मेति भोजाय मृगाननया कथनम्, द्वार-वतीकुरुक्षेत्रादिबहुतीर्थक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, स्वर्णरेखायां मृगाननायाः पूर्वजन्म-मृगमुखप्रक्षेपणेन दिव्यमुखत्वप्राप्त्युत्तरं भोजनृपतिपरिणयवृत्तान्तपूर्वकं स्वर्ण-रेखामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... .. ... ... ... ... 206 1
17.20.m: 6 Description of the procedure for pilgrimage to Cakratīrtha; the reporting to King Bhoja by a certain forest-guardian that a young girl leaping like a deer was seen; upon hearing that, the giving of much wealth to that forest-guardian by Bhoja, who was pleased; then, having gone to that forest along with that forest-guardian, Bhoja's capturing that deer-faced girl and going to his own house; then, when Bhoja asked that girl the reason for her curse consisting of a human body and a deer's face, her non-speaking, and Bhoja's asking of the brahmins; then, the description of the account of both their previous seven births recounted by the deer-faced [girl] who obtained clear speech after eating the puroḍāśa offered by the great sage belonging to Sarasvatī. [p.] 203.1 / 7 In the conversation between the deer-faced [girl] and King Bhoja, regarding the occasion of the description of her own origin, the seer Uddālaka's going to another forest to discharge urine; there, the falling of a drop of his semen; there, the drinking of Uddālaka's drop of semen by a female deer; then, the recounting to Bhoja by the deer-faced [girl] of her own birth from Uddālaka through the female deer; description of the māhātmya of many sacred fields and sacred fords such as Dvāravatī and Kurukṣetra; the description of the māhātmya of the Svarṇarekhā preceded by the account of her marriage to King Bhoja following her attainment of a divine face by casting away the previous birth's deer-face into the Svarṇarekhā. [p.] 206.1

8 In the conversation between the [sage] belonging to Sarasvatī and Bhoja, in the dispute between Brahmā and Rudra, description of the propitiation of Rudra performed by Brahmā at the word of Viṣṇu. [p.] 207.1

17.20.s: 9 brahmaṇe viṣṇunā dakṣayajñakathādivarṇane dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsavarṇanam, pārvatījananavi-vāhādivarṇanam ta tata ekasminsamaye'ntardhānaṃ gataṃ śaṃkaramadṛṣṭvā siṃhārūḍhayā pārvatyā samaṃ viṣṇvādidevānāṃ śivānveṣaṇāya gamanam, tataḥ prabhāse vastrāpatha-kṣetre taiḥ śaṃkarasya darśanam, viṣṇvādyājñayā śaṃkareṇa bhaveti nāmnā svasyā mūrte--statra vastrāpathakṣetre sthāpanam, bhavotpattimāhātmyavarṇanam... 207 2
17.20.d: 9 ब्रह्मणे विष्णुना दक्षयज्ञकथादिवर्णने दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसवर्णनम्, पार्वतीजननवि-वाहादिवर्णनम् त तत एकस्मिन्समयेऽन्तर्धानं गतं शंकरमदृष्ट्वा सिंहारूढया पार्वत्या समं विष्ण्वादिदेवानां शिवान्वेषणाय गमनम्, ततः प्रभासे वस्त्रापथ-क्षेत्रे तैः शंकरस्य दर्शनम्, विष्ण्वाद्याज्ञया शंकरेण भवेति नाम्ना स्वस्या मूर्ते--स्तत्र वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रे स्थापनम्, भवोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... 207 2
17.20.m: 9 In the description by Viṣṇu to Brahmā of the story of Dakṣa's sacrifice and other matters, the description of the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice; description of the birth, marriage, and other deeds of Pārvatī; then, upon not seeing Śaṃkara who had disappeared at one time, the departure of the gods led by Viṣṇu together with Pārvatī mounted on a lion in order to search for Śiva; then, the darśana of Śaṃkara by them in the Vastrāpathakṣetra at Prabhāsa; the installation of his own form named Bhava there in the Vastrāpathakṣetra by Śaṃkara upon the command of Viṣṇu and others; description of the māhātmya of the origin of Bhava. [p.] 207.2
10 Description of the instruction given by the sage belonging to Sarasvatī to King Bhoja, who was eager for pilgrimage to the Vastrāpathakṣetra. [p.] 212.2
11 Description of the rules and sequence for the pilgrimage to the Vastrāpathakṣetra. [p.] 213.1

17.20.s: 12 śrāddhakaraṇe gajacchāyādidinamāhātmyavarṇanam, yātrākāribhistyājyadoṣādivarṇanam, bhīmeśvaraskāndarāmeśvarādyanyānyatīrtheṣu snānadānādiphalavarṇanam, tīrthasmaraṇa-phalakathanam, yātrāvidhivarṇanam ... ... ... ...... 214 1
17.20.d: 12 श्राद्धकरणे गजच्छायादिदिनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, यात्राकारिभिस्त्याज्यदोषादिवर्णनम्, भीमेश्वरस्कान्दरामेश्वराद्यन्यान्यतीर्थेषु स्नानदानादिफलवर्णनम्, तीर्थस्मरण-फलकथनम्, यात्राविधिवर्णनम् ... ... ... ...... 214 1
17.20.m: 12 In performing śrāddha, description of the māhātmya of days such as Gajacchāyā; description of the faults to be abandoned by pilgrims; description of the fruits of ritual ablution, gifting, and other rites at various sacred fords such as Bhīmeśvara, Skānda, and Rāmeśvara; stating the fruit of remembering sacred fords; description of the procedure for pilgrimage. [p.] 214.1

13 Stating the fruit of the worship of Harihara; stating the fruit of ritual ablution, gifting, recitation, oblations, and the worship of gods and the twice-born there; description of the path of smoke and the path of rays; description of the māhātmya of śrāddha, gifting, and other rites. [p.] 215.1

17.20.s: 14 vāmanapure putraśokābhisaṃtaptena vasiṣṭhena svarṇarekhātaṭe tapastaptvā śivaprasādena tatraiva liṃgasthāpanam, tato vāmanasthāpitasomanāthamāhātmyavarṇane balividrāvitai- rdevairviṣṇuṃ prati śaraṇagamanam, tato viṣṇunā devakāryārthaṃ vāmanarūpaṃ dhṛtvā balisabhāyāṃ pādatrayabhūmigrahaṇena balinigrahakaraṇottaraṃ somanāthamārādhya liṃgasthāpanam, someśvarotpattivarṇanam .... .. ........ 216 1
17.20.d: 14 वामनपुरे पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तेन वसिष्ठेन स्वर्णरेखातटे तपस्तप्त्वा शिवप्रसादेन तत्रैव लिंगस्थापनम्, ततो वामनस्थापितसोमनाथमाहात्म्यवर्णने बलिविद्रावितै- र्देवैर्विष्णुं प्रति शरणगमनम्, ततो विष्णुना देवकार्यार्थं वामनरूपं धृत्वा बलिसभायां पादत्रयभूमिग्रहणेन बलिनिग्रहकरणोत्तरं सोमनाथमाराध्य लिंगस्थापनम्, सोमेश्वरोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् .... .. ........ 216 1
17.20.m: 14 In Vāmanapura, after performing austerity on the bank of the Svarṇarekhā by Vasiṣṭha, who was tormented by grief for his son, the installation of a liṅga right there through the grace of Śiva; then, in the description of the māhātmya of the Somanātha installed by Vāmana, the taking of refuge with Viṣṇu by the gods put to flight by Bali; then, Viṣṇu's assuming the form of Vāmana for the purpose of the gods, taking three paces of earth in the assembly of Bali, and after subduing Bali, his worship of Somanātha and installing a liṅga; description of the origin of Someśvara. [p.] 216.1

17.20.s: 15 vāmanasya dāmodaradarśanaṃ grahītuṃ raivatakāraṇye gamanam, tatra nṛsiṃhaṃ saṃpūjya snāna-dānādikaṃ vidhāya tata uttaraṃ dāmodaradarśanāya vastrāpathakṣetre gamanam, tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prati gamanam, dāmodarāgre jāgarasya māhātmyavarṇanam .. 218 1
17.20.d: 15 वामनस्य दामोदरदर्शनं ग्रहीतुं रैवतकारण्ये गमनम्, तत्र नृसिंहं संपूज्य स्नान-दानादिकं विधाय तत उत्तरं दामोदरदर्शनाय वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रे गमनम्, तत्र जागरणं कृत्वा सिद्धिं प्रति गमनम्, दामोदराग्रे जागरस्य माहात्म्यवर्णनम् .. 218 1
17.20.m: 15 Vāmana's going to the Raivataka forest to receive darśana of Dāmodara; there, after thoroughly worshipping Nṛsiṃha and performing ritual ablution, gifting, and other rites, going thereafter to the Vastrāpathakṣetra for darśana of Dāmodara; there, after performing a night vigil, his departure towards perfection; description of the māhātmya of the night vigil before Dāmodara. [p.] 218.1

17.20.s: 16 tato vāmanasya yātrārthaṃ gahane'raṇye gamanam, anekatīrthakṣetradarśanottaraṃ mārge śivasya darśanam, śivavāmanasaṃvādavarṇanam, tatra śivena vāmanāyendreśvaramāhātmya-kathanam, śivarātrimāhātmyavarṇanam, śivarātrivratavidhikathanaṃ ca.... ... 219 2
17.20.d: 16 ततो वामनस्य यात्रार्थं गहनेऽरण्ये गमनम्, अनेकतीर्थक्षेत्रदर्शनोत्तरं मार्गे शिवस्य दर्शनम्, शिववामनसंवादवर्णनम्, तत्र शिवेन वामनायेन्द्रेश्वरमाहात्म्य-कथनम्, शिवरात्रिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, शिवरात्रिव्रतविधिकथनं च.... ... 219 2
17.20.m: 16 Then, Vāmana's going into the dense forest for the sake of pilgrimage; after seeing many sacred fields and sacred fords, the darśana of Śiva on the path; description of the conversation between Śiva and Vāmana; there, the recounting of the māhātmya of Indreśvara to Vāmana by Śiva; description of the māhātmya of Śivarātri, and statement of the rules for the Śivarātri observance. [p.] 219.2

17.20.s: 17 bhṛguṇā śaptaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā devo'pi vāmanāvatārarūpeṇa balinigrahaṃ kariṣyatīti jñātvā nāradasya baleragre gamanam, tatra nāradena balaye tvatto'pi devendralakṣmī- radhikatareti nivedya balermanaḥ kṣobhayitvā samudramanthanasamaye devakṛtavañcanasyāpi balaye smaraṇaṃ kārayitvā svargaṃ pratyetya śakrāyāpi nāradena tathaiva kathanam, evaṃ mithaḥ kalahā-dinā parasparaṃ saṃkṣobhya nāradena balaye rājanītidharmaśāstrādivyavahārakathanam, raivatakaparvatotpattivarṇane merordakṣiṇasthe kumudaparvate viṣṇumandire sthitaṃ devaṃ draṣṭuṃ viṣṇoraharaharāgamanam, kumudena tatraiva kumudaparvate hariharayoḥ sthāpanam, kumudaparvatāya hariharābhyāṃ varapradānam, tato raivatanāmakapañcamamanvantara ṛtavā-gṛṣito mūḍhaputrotpattāvṛtavāggargayoḥ saṃvāde revatyṛkṣajanitasvaputrasya mauḍhyadoṣaṃ śrutvā kruddhenartavācarṣiṇā svadṛṣṭinikṣepeṇa revatyṛkṣasyādhaḥ pātanam, tataḥ kumuda-parvate revatyṛkṣasya patanam, tena kumudādre raivataketināmnā prasiddhivarṇanam, tato raivatakagire revatīnāmakakanyotpattivarṇanam, revatyā pramuñcarājarṣiṇā pālana-karaṇam, agnivacanātpramuñcena durdamarājāya revatīpradānakaraṇam, revatīkuṇḍe snānena devateti khyātaputrasya janma, vaiṣṇavapūjyaśivālakṣmīvṛkṣamāhātmyavarṇanam, nāradena balaye vaiṣṇavavratajāgarādividhikathanam, tathaiva balinā vaiṣṇavavratajāga-rādikaṃ kṛtvā sañcalitotpātanāśanāya śukrānujñayā brāhmaṇānāhūya yajñasamāraṃbha-karaṇam, baliyajñaprabhāvavarṇanam ... ... .-.. - ... 222 2
17.20.d: 17 भृगुणा शप्तं देवं दृष्ट्वा देवोऽपि वामनावताररूपेण बलिनिग्रहं करिष्यतीति ज्ञात्वा नारदस्य बलेरग्रे गमनम्, तत्र नारदेन बलये त्वत्तोऽपि देवेन्द्रलक्ष्मी- रधिकतरेति निवेद्य बलेर्मनः क्षोभयित्वा समुद्रमन्थनसमये देवकृतवञ्चनस्यापि बलये स्मरणं कारयित्वा स्वर्गं प्रत्येत्य शक्रायापि नारदेन तथैव कथनम्, एवं मिथः कलहा-दिना परस्परं संक्षोभ्य नारदेन बलये राजनीतिधर्मशास्त्रादिव्यवहारकथनम्, रैवतकपर्वतोत्पत्तिवर्णने मेरोर्दक्षिणस्थे कुमुदपर्वते विष्णुमन्दिरे स्थितं देवं द्रष्टुं विष्णोरहरहरागमनम्, कुमुदेन तत्रैव कुमुदपर्वते हरिहरयोः स्थापनम्, कुमुदपर्वताय हरिहराभ्यां वरप्रदानम्, ततो रैवतनामकपञ्चममन्वन्तर ऋतवा-गृषितो मूढपुत्रोत्पत्तावृतवाग्गर्गयोः संवादे रेवत्यृक्षजनितस्वपुत्रस्य मौढ्यदोषं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धेनर्तवाचर्षिणा स्वदृष्टिनिक्षेपेण रेवत्यृक्षस्याधः पातनम्, ततः कुमुद-पर्वते रेवत्यृक्षस्य पतनम्, तेन कुमुदाद्रे रैवतकेतिनाम्ना प्रसिद्धिवर्णनम्, ततो रैवतकगिरे रेवतीनामककन्योत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, रेवत्या प्रमुञ्चराजर्षिणा पालन-करणम्, अग्निवचनात्प्रमुञ्चेन दुर्दमराजाय रेवतीप्रदानकरणम्, रेवतीकुण्डे स्नानेन देवतेति ख्यातपुत्रस्य जन्म, वैष्णवपूज्यशिवालक्ष्मीवृक्षमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, नारदेन बलये वैष्णवव्रतजागरादिविधिकथनम्, तथैव बलिना वैष्णवव्रतजाग-रादिकं कृत्वा सञ्चलितोत्पातनाशनाय शुक्रानुज्ञया ब्राह्मणानाहूय यज्ञसमारंभ-करणम्, बलियज्ञप्रभाववर्णनम् ... ... .-.. - ... 222 2
17.20.m: 17 Seeing the god cursed by Bhṛgu, and knowing that the god would also subdue Bali in the form of the Vāmana incarnation, Nārada's going before Bali; there, Nārada's agitating Bali's mind by stating that the glory of Devendra was greater even than his, and also causing Bali to remember the deception practiced by the gods at the time of the churning of the ocean; returning to heaven, Nārada's speaking in the very same way to Śakra as well; having thus mutually agitated them through strife and other means, Nārada's exposition of statecraft, the treatises on dharma, and other conduct to Bali; in the description of the origin of Mount Raivataka, the daily arrival of Viṣṇu to see the god staying in the temple of Viṣṇu on Mount Kumuda situated south of Meru; the installation of Hari and Hara right there on Mount Kumuda by Kumuda; the granting of a boon to Mount Kumuda by Hari and Hara; then, in the fifth Manvantara named Raivata, upon the birth of a dull-witted son to the seer Ṛtavāc, in the conversation between Ṛtavāc and Garga, after hearing of the flaw of dullness in his own son born under the asterism Revatī, the casting down of the asterism Revatī by the enraged seer Ṛtavāc by directing his glance; then, the falling of the asterism Revatī upon Mount Kumuda; thereby, the description of the renown of the Kumuda mountain by the name Raivataka; then, the birth of a girl named Revatī from Mount Raivataka; the raising of Revatī by the royal seer Pramuñca; from the word of Agni, Pramuñca's giving of Revatī to King Durdama; by bathing in the Revatīkuṇḍa, the birth of a son known as Devata; description of the māhātmya of the Śivālakṣmī tree worthy of worship by Vaiṣṇavas; the instruction to Bali by Nārada on the rules for the Vaiṣṇava vow, vigil, and other rites; Bali's performing the Vaiṣṇava vow, vigil, and other rites accordingly, and summoning brahmins with the permission of Śukra to commence a sacrifice in order to destroy impending portents; description of the power of Bali's sacrifice. Īśvara said:
Then, at a certain time, O dear one, the two divine Aśvins / saw that Sukanyā, who had performed her ablutions and was unclothed. 1
Seeing her of handsome limbs, like the daughter of the king of gods, / the two Nāsatya-Aśvins then ran toward her and said: 2
"Whose [daughter] are you, O fair-thighed one? What do you wish to do in this forest? / We two wish to know you; tell us the truth, O fair lady!" 3
Then Sukanyā, having covered herself, said to those two best of gods: / "Know me to be the daughter of Śaryāti and the wife of Cyavana." 4

Then, having heard—Śaryāti, stationed in the Valabhī region, / having heard that Cyavana was endowed with youth, his mind overwhelmed with joy, / 1
greatly delighted, went with his army to the hermitage of the descendant of Bhṛgu; / and [he saw] Cyavana and Sukanyā, delighted like a daughter of the gods. / 2
King Śaryāti, a great ocean of complete bliss, having arrived, / that ruler of the earth, along with his wife, was honoured by the seer.
Seated there, the noble-minded one engaged in auspicious conversations. / 3

Then, extremely delighted, king Śaryāti, the ruler of the earth, / worshipped that word of Cyavana, O great goddess. / 5
